# Introduction

Welcome on KKiaPay ! Get familiar with KKiaPay's products and explore their features.

### Try now !

Our strong and flexible infrastructure will provide you the payment processing experience you need. Integrate the KKiaPay's API in seconds and receive your first payments ! On your website or in your mobile application, integrate our plugins and SDK and give your customers the best possible payment experience.

Whether you are starting an online store, a point-of-sale system or a fundraiser ? We are here to help you ! Ask us your questions. Tell us about your misunderstandings by calling +229 61151561 or by writing to <support@kkiapay.me>.

Our support team is available to help you.


# KKiaPay

Designed for you, this guide provides you the informations you need to get started with KKiaPay.

## Welcome on KKiaPay !

KKiaPay is a tool that allows you to receive payments from anywhere in the world. It is a user-friendly solution, whose integration offers you the possibility to accept payments made by Mobile Money (all operators combined) and by Credit Cards (local and international).

To use KKiaPay you must have a valid merchant account. If you do not have one yet, you can now [create one](https://kkiapay.me). It's free of charge !&#x20;

KKiaPay provides **SDKs** and **Plugins** for most of the technologies you use in order to facilitate its integration.

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="With a Native platform (Web or Mobile)" %}
A Javascript SDK and an Android SDK are available and can be integrated into your application code.
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="With a CMS" %}
You also have a WooCommerce plugin and a Prestashop plugin that can be integrated into your platform when it is developed with Wordpress or Prestashop.
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}


# Create an account

Create your account to collect your first payment today !

With your phone number or email address, proceed to the creation of your KKiaPay account and offer your customers the KKiaPay experience. In your mobile application or on your website; on WhatsApp, Facebook, Messenger, and even by SMS, get paid in one click. Whether you sell locally or internationally, accept payments from anywhere in the world by creating your account now.&#x20;

To get started, choose how you want to create your KKiaPay account. Would you like to create your KKiaPay account using your phone number or email address ?&#x20;

### Create my KKiaPay account from my phone number&#x20;

In order to initiate the process of creating your KKiaPay account, enter the phone number you wish to link to your KKiaPay account and choose the KKiaPay offer that best suits the experience you wish to offer your customers. Would you like to benefit from KKiaPay's Standard or Professional offer ?&#x20;

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MN82X4XusMK2varPbwA%2F-MN88IEp-Mb6QQZ1yYky%2F1.png?alt=media\&token=a6874c80-5cdb-4cc9-bc71-f7dcaff99d1f)

Once the answer to this question has been entered in the *"Select an offer"* field, click on the *"Validate"* button to continue. You will then receive a six (06) digit verification code on the phone number provided. Fill it in in the fields provided and click on the *"Verify"* button to continue.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MN82X4XusMK2varPbwA%2F-MN8DDDNpcxpHIf-puuP%2F2.png?alt=media\&token=2e15a842-3630-4533-ac30-b8440bc4abb1)

{% hint style="warning" %}
If you have not received a verification code, click on the "Resend Code" link to request a new verification code.
{% endhint %}

&#x20;If you have made it this far, first of all : **CONGRATULATIONS !** You have only one step left to start collecting your payments.&#x20;

In the information form that appears after verification of the code, enter :&#x20;

* Your first and last names&#x20;
* Your email address&#x20;
* The name of your company&#x20;

Continue by choosing your password. Your password must contain :&#x20;

* An uppercase letter&#x20;
* 8 characters minimum&#x20;
* One number&#x20;
* A special character (#?\*+/)&#x20;

Click on the *"Next"* button to request the creation of your KKiaPay account.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MN82X4XusMK2varPbwA%2F-MN8EfGDWPTau7Fd_Dnu%2F3.png?alt=media\&token=47e20766-1b48-464c-b731-be9a259ced26)

Read and accept the various general conditions of use of KKiaPay and click on the *"Next"* button to confirm your account creation request and actually create your KKiaPay account.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MNO-3oTRTJylg4qAePE%2F-MNO-88aMQOIw-bvKcca%2FScreen%20Shot%202020-11-30%20at%2012.21.34%20PM.png?alt=media\&token=4de657aa-5b0e-4d31-b92e-15ecd35f4cbf)

You can then connect and receive payments made by Mobile Money (all operators combined) and by Credit Cards (local and international).

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MO0kJItXt_SQcIn3Ddq%2F-MO0o9HYq7p0HqrnWFr8%2FPhone.png?alt=media\&token=1b2e9d1f-ed5a-46cb-8f90-cad2d23ad1b2)

### Create my KKiaPay account from my email address

In order to initiate the process of creating your KKiaPay account, fill in the e-mail address you wish to link to your KKiaPay account and choose the KKiaPay offer that corresponds to your needs.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MO0kJItXt_SQcIn3Ddq%2F-MO0rKjGw4POqQNI-hdH%2F1.png?alt=media\&token=1460c964-b1c6-4d41-a1e0-88f33efea7e2)

Click on the *"Validate"* button to continue.&#x20;

A verification link will be sent to the email address you entered. Click on this link to continue your registration on KKiaPay and confirm that the previously submitted e-mail address is indeed active.&#x20;

{% hint style="warning" %}
If you have not received your verification e-mail, please check your spam mails as a first reflex. If this does not prove to be conclusive, you can ask for it to be resent by clicking on *"Resend it"*.
{% endhint %}

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MO0kJItXt_SQcIn3Ddq%2F-MO0t9yT65D2anEaET9v%2F2.png?alt=media\&token=3c33ffde-033f-4639-9ba4-d602af12caac)

When you click on the verification link, you will be redirected to the form to submit the various information to your relative persons and companies. In this form, please fill in the following information :&#x20;

* Your first and last names&#x20;
* Your email address&#x20;
* The name of your company&#x20;
* Your Password&#x20;

The latter must contain :&#x20;

* An uppercase letter&#x20;
* 8 characters minimum&#x20;
* One number&#x20;
* A special character (#?\*+/)&#x20;

Then click the *"Next"* button to continue.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MN82X4XusMK2varPbwA%2F-MN8EfGDWPTau7Fd_Dnu%2F3.png?alt=media\&token=47e20766-1b48-464c-b731-be9a259ced26)

Read and accept the various general conditions of use of KKiaPay and click on the *"Next"* button to proceed with the creation of your KKiaPay account.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MNO-3oTRTJylg4qAePE%2F-MNO-88aMQOIw-bvKcca%2FScreen%20Shot%202020-11-30%20at%2012.21.34%20PM.png?alt=media\&token=4de657aa-5b0e-4d31-b92e-15ecd35f4cbf)

You can then log in using your email address and password to receive payments made by Mobile Money (all operators) and Credit Cards (local and international).

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MO0kJItXt_SQcIn3Ddq%2F-MO1ym81KEe-BWHSI2zK%2FEmail.png?alt=media\&token=1d061512-8530-4981-91e7-8bc4f5f36638)


# Account activation

Request in a few clicks the activation of your KKiaPay account to start receiving payments from anywhere in the world.

Creating a KKiaPay account allows you to immediately interact with the KKiaPay environment in test mode. All KKiaPay features are available in test mode, but you cannot perform any real transactions. To start accepting customer payments, you must first have an active account.&#x20;

Activating your KKiaPay account is a simple process. You can request it from the **Activate My Account** menu on your dashboard.

{% hint style="warning" %}
All documents submitted for account activation must be scanned and clear versions of the original documents.
{% endhint %}

## The account activation request

To request the activation of your KKiaPay account, you must, in the three sections below mentioned fill in the requested information :&#x20;

1. **Personal Information**&#x20;
2. **Information about the company**&#x20;
3. **Administrative documents**

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlFzy-2RbrKcz9_EqV-%2FEdit-business-info%20\(1\).png?alt=media\&token=a9e8be92-b200-413c-9ac1-f2815fa5a8fe)

After filling in your full names, telephone and your role in the ***"Personal information***" section, fill in the information form concerning your company by providing :&#x20;

* the name of your company&#x20;
* your field of activity&#x20;
* the link to your website or application (if you have one)&#x20;
* the telephone of the company and the country in which it is registered (Benin or Côte d'Ivoire)&#x20;
* the physical address of the company

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlG0dtrgxujyONdBoi-%2FEdit-business-info%20\(1\).png?alt=media\&token=9146a1c8-3060-4c49-ae74-93e2ebacd4ae)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlFwpwqmVz0598T5qtS%2FEdit-business-info.png?alt=media\&token=36d380e6-408a-46e4-9cef-08f72dbfa791)

In the "***Administrative Documents***" section of the validation process, you must provide supporting documents for your activity. The documents required at this step vary depending on the type of your business and the country in which it is registered.&#x20;

### For companies registered in Benin&#x20;

#### 1. Establishments/sole proprietorships/corporations&#x20;

To apply for account activation, institutions, sole proprietorships, and corporations must provide :&#x20;

* the number of their Trade and Personal Property Credit Register&#x20;
* a copy of their Trade and Personal Property Credit Register&#x20;
* the number of their Unique Tax Identifier&#x20;
* a copy of their Unique Tax Identifier&#x20;
* the identity document (identity card or passport) of the company manager

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlFiZEmezJe5R4dEYCo%2FEdit-business-info.png?alt=media\&token=19ce3029-58ce-420a-852a-cd545b428476)

#### 2. Non-Governmental Organization (NGO)

To request the activation of your KKiaPay account, the NGO or association must provide :

* a copy of the minutes of its constituent meeting&#x20;
* a copy of its declaration receipt
* the identity document (identity card or passport) of the president of the NGO (or association)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlFipEK92s1t84-U9GR%2FEdit-business-info%20\(1\).png?alt=media\&token=e9ce881a-1ca2-4ac0-ac75-a0f4cdfef679)

#### 3. Individual Consultant&#x20;

The individual consultant must provide :&#x20;

* his/her Unique Tax Identifier number&#x20;
* a copy of its Unique Tax Identifier&#x20;
* his/her date of birth proof of residence (also called proof of residence)&#x20;
* his/her identification (identity card or passport)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlFjE_g2L64HL5sDLXp%2FEdit-business-info%20\(2\).png?alt=media\&token=aa251ae8-e406-49c1-b71e-23acf9a8d9b1)

### For companies registered in Ivory Coast

#### 1. Sole proprietorship/LLC/SARLU/SAS/SASU

To request account activation, individual companies/SARL/SARLU/SAS/SASU must provide :&#x20;

* the number of their Trade and Personal Property Credit Register&#x20;
* a copy of their Trade and Personal Property Credit Register&#x20;
* the number of their Tax Declaration Of Existence (DFE)&#x20;
* a copy of their Existence Tax Declaration&#x20;
* their Taxpayer Account Number (NCC)&#x20;
* the identity document (identity card or passport) of the company manager

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlFl-81rMsMk82abaro%2FEdit-business-info%20\(3\).png?alt=media\&token=7baebf5b-f4da-474b-bad0-4583790867e2)

#### 2. Non-Governmental Organization (NGO)

To request the activation of your KKiaPay account, the NGO or association registered in Ivory Coast must provide :

* a copy of the minutes of its constituent meeting&#x20;
* a copy of its declaration receipt
* the identity document (identity card or passport) of the president of the NGO (or association)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlFlmluH714PRMkNUVw%2FEdit-business-info%20\(5\).png?alt=media\&token=f9984321-e240-46e6-8f73-0917cab7c914)

Complete by clicking the ***Submit Verification Request*** button.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlF7fzWsuWIAjvQt_U-%2F-MlFmSYPlOS9hAm5q0gL%2FHome%20\(2\).png?alt=media\&token=cce84206-3e21-4c4f-9356-c92910c81bdd)

Within 24 hours, our team will verify your documents to activate your account to start receiving your payments remotely.&#x20;

These requirements come from our regulators and financial partners and are designed to prevent fraud, abuse of the financial system. The information you provide is reviewed internally to ensure compliance with our service contract. If we need more information, we will contact you immediately.<br>


# KKiaPay Sandbox : Test Guide

Test the features of KKiaPay using the test information available

The KKiaPay Sandbox is an independant virtual test environment that mimics the KKiaPay live production environment. It provides an secure area where you can launch and watch your application process the requests you send to the KKiaPay APIs without touching any active KKiaPay account.

When you create your account, KKiaPay sends you a *Welcome on KKiaPay* email to the address you specify. The content of this email instructs you on how to request the activation of your merchant account. If you don't receive this email within minutes of registering, check that it hasn't been blocked or forwarded to a spam folder.

It only takes a few seconds to test the KKiaPay environment after creating your account. Once your account has been created, access the Sandbox functionality by connecting to the KKiaPay web platform using your account login access.

## Sandbox : Overview

The KKiaPay Sandbox reflects the features found on KKiaPay production servers. Although some KKiaPay features do not apply to the sandbox, it still has parity with the KKiaPay API feature set supported by the live environment. This means that you can test your KKiaPay processes and know then how they will behave on your production servers.

By using the fictitious sandbox test environment and associated account information in your KKiaPay API calls, you can test and debug your application without referring to any real KKiaPay users. The sandbox environment allows you to operate your application in a secure environment and to fine-tune your KKiaPay routines before putting your product into production.

When you start a transaction using a sandbox account, KKiaPay creates a fake transaction that behaves exactly like a transaction in the online environment. During your test phase, use the sandbox endpoints and your account test credentials in each KKiaPay API request you make.

## Related information

Information related to your merchant account cannot (and should not) be used in test mode. We provide you this list of numbers that you can use to perform your tests. The Scenario column shows you the numbers with which you can simulate a successful or failed transaction to see how your system will react in each of these cases.

### Test phone numbers

To simulate all the scenarios of mobile money transactions that you deem necessary before going into production on your live account, we provide you the following numbers:

During your test phase you evolve with the KKiaPay test server which receives and handles the processing of your requests when you are in test mode. In sandbox environment, you must use your test api keys which are available on the dashboard.

When you go into production on your live account, you will need to replace the test API keys with the API keys from your live account. This will be enough to make your payment system operational.


# Using KKiaPay

Get your API keys and integrate KKiaPay !

The creation of a KKiaPay account, offers you the possibility to retrieve your API keys in order to integrate the aggregator on your platform.

### Recovery of KKiaPay API keys

It concerns the "**API Keys**" submenu of the "**Developers**" menu. A KKiaPay account has three (03) API keys associated with it: a private key, a public key and a secret key.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZZyL95PHz53jcUQM1n%2F-LZZtuNatbZ8b1ahrDgc%2FAPI-Key.png?alt=media\&token=3c5b80fc-7511-4629-9177-8fb971694d91)

[What are they used for and how can they be used?](/v1/en-1.0.0/tableau-de-bord/untitled/menu-developpeurs)

### Integration of KKiaPay

You have the choice when integrating KKiaPay, depending on your technology, to use the [plugin](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/woo-commerce) or [SDK](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/sdk-javascript) we provide you.&#x20;

In the case of an e-commerce site created using Wordpress or Prestashop, you will need to integrate our [WooCommerce](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/woo-commerce) or [Prestashop](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/prestashop) plugin. It will then serve as a gateway between your customers and your services. In the case of a web application, use [Javascript SDK](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/sdk-javascript) and [Android SDK](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/sdk-android) in the case of a mobile application.


# Supported Currencies

Check the currencies supported by your payment aggregator.

Currently, on KKiaPay you can only make transactions in CFA (Fcfa). The ISO 4217 code for this currency is XOF. Gradually other currencies will be added.


# Payment Methods

Find out about the payment methods related to KKiaPay !

All customer transactions are carried out using the payment method chosen by the customer. The payment methods currently offered by KKiaPay are:&#x20;

* Mobile money (MTN Mobile Money and Moov Money) ;
* Credit Card (Visa, Mastercard).

### Mobile money: MTN Mobile Money and Moov Money

<div align="center"><img src="https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZ_7nssDYqk5u-ZtPxF%2F-LZ_7s_JktjEUPGtDxNw%2FMM.png?alt=media&amp;token=e549f4c4-f30a-46a0-b158-bea2939b64cc" alt=""></div>

In order to make a payment via mobile money, the customer must have a valid MTN Mobile Money or Moov Money account and provide his full name and telephone number. He will then receive a message from his mobile phone operator informing him of the debit transaction to which his account is then subject. If he has the required amount and chooses to approve the transaction, his account is debited and the merchant's KKiaPay account is credited.

### Credit Card (Visa, MasterCard)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZ_7nssDYqk5u-ZtPxF%2F-LZ_7s_1g2A4K-WN_Ntz%2FCards.png?alt=media\&token=f3ca82de-0da1-4e09-8cb5-95c78080aa5a)

In order to make an online purchase using his credit card, the customer must provide the following information:&#x20;

* His full name;&#x20;
* The credit card number (16 digits);
* The expiry date of the credit card (MM / YY);
* The credit card security code (03 digits).

The bank where the customer has subscribed his credit card then debits his account (when he has the required amount on his account) and informs him by sending him a notification by email or SMS. KKiaPay is then informed of this debit transaction and notifies the customer of the success of its transaction and credits your KKiaPay account with the said amount.

Please note that the currency used to make payments must be CFA (FCFA).


# Fees

Transactions on KKiaPay may be subject to charges levied. Be informed of the amount of these.

Your KKiaPay transactions, regarding on their nature, are subject to fees charged by the payment aggregator. These fees are charged at two levels:

* When the customer purchases your products or services;&#x20;
* When KKiaPay transfers your assets to you.

### Fees charged to your customers

When your customers make purchases on your e-commerce site using the mobile money payment method, they are charged at **3%** of the total amount of the purchases that they made.&#x20;

### Fees collected from the merchant

In the case of a payment by credit card, the merchant is charged at 3.5% of the total amount of purchases made by his customer.

Similarly, KKiaPay collects fees from the merchant at the time of the transfer of its credit notes.&#x20;

In the case of a transfer to your mobile money account, KKiaPay waives your transaction fees.&#x20;

In the case of a transfer of your assets on² your bank account, a sum of **7000 CFA** is deducted from your account regardless of the amount repaid.


# Payouts

With KKiaPay, you can recover your assets at any time.

You can at any time, request from your merchant account the return of the sums collected from your customers. This is called a reversal. A payment transaction is performed on **a Mobile Money account** or **a bank account** from the available balance displayed on your merchant dashboard.&#x20;

Indeed, three (03) types of balance are displayed on the KKiaPay dashboard :&#x20;

* **The total balance :** It accumulates all the transactions (reversed and reversed) carried out by the merchant since the activation of his account.&#x20;
* **The available balance :** It is the sum of all transactions that can be reversed.&#x20;
* **The operation balance :** These are all client transactions awaiting payment. When a payment is made using KKiaPay, the amount received is immediately stored in the operation balance. This amount will migrate from the operation balance to the availability balance: &#x20;
  * ***the same day*** when the payment is made by Mobile Money&#x20;
  * ***72 hours later*** in the case of payment by Credit Cards

{% hint style="danger" %}
The merchant will not be able to be repaid if his available balance is zero.
{% endhint %}

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlJQcAASwV9biEkqaEq%2F-MlJrln_lO3w21ouHeHt%2FGroup%20260.png?alt=media\&token=c3ea8f11-fade-4a6c-a9c1-a615d5817b32)

**Configuration of the payout method**&#x20;

You can configure your payout preferences in the KKiaPay [Settings](/v1/en-1.0.0/tableau-de-bord/untitled/menu-parametres) menu. Three (03) payouts modes are available : period payout, level payout, and instant payout.&#x20;

#### Payout by period&#x20;

The payout by period allows you to define a time interval/frequency at which you wish to proceed with the recovery of your various assets. If the available balance of your account allows you to do so, you can be reimbursed :&#x20;

* Every 03 days&#x20;
* Every 07 days (Weekly payout)&#x20;
* Every 30 days (Monthly payout)

Thus, depending on the frequency chosen, your entire available balance will be transferred to a Mobile Money or bank account.&#x20;

#### Level Payout

The level payout allows you to specify from which amount available on your account, KKiaPay will have to pay you back your assets. This amount is variable, but may not be less than **50,000 Fcfa**.

![](https://gblobscdn.gitbook.com/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlJQcAASwV9biEkqaEq%2F-MlJuazNA1ptK4pt9RAs%2FFrame%20614.png?alt=media\&token=21182e4c-33dd-41b4-862f-2e8c52016cce)

**Instant Payout**

{% hint style="warning" %}
This option is only available for merchants who have subscribed to the KKiaPay professional offer.&#x20;
{% endhint %}

This type of payout allows a KKiaPay professional merchant to receive, immediately, all or part (amount to be defined) of its available balance. It allows the merchant to be paid up to **300000 FCFA per week**.&#x20;

On the KKiaPay account home page of a KKiaPay professional merchant you will find the "*Request an instant payment*" button. A click on the latter initiates the process of spontaneous reversal.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlJQcAASwV9biEkqaEq%2F-MlJuKRr-oG_9as7_UvT%2FGroup%20261.png?alt=media\&token=f80ccec9-d580-4843-bf64-81c4b868cd5e)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlJQcAASwV9biEkqaEq%2F-MlJt0Imbb2sj8pzZMs9%2FHome-3%20\(1\).png?alt=media\&token=f441d6f1-bc3f-4896-9a38-b6784efb32e2)

### Payout to a mobile money account

You can request the payout of your assets to a mobile money account. To do this, you will need to add the phone number as a payout mode. A code will then be sent by KKiaPay to the number provided to verify it.

{% hint style="info" %}
No charges are applied to the payouts made on a mobile money account
{% endhint %}

### Payout to a bank account

In order to request a refund of your assets via a bank account, you must add the said account from your dashboard.&#x20;

{% hint style="warning" %}
Payouts via bank account are subject to transaction costs amounting to **7000 CFA**  per repayment, regardless of the amount of the said repayment.
{% endhint %}

![](https://gblobscdn.gitbook.com/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MlJQcAASwV9biEkqaEq%2F-MlJzxftljjztL_xMlhj%2FHome-1%20\(1\).png?alt=media\&token=3dfe9949-86b1-4ca3-b523-75d6a60415d0)


# Transactions

A transaction is a financial operation involving a merchant (you) and a buyer (your customer). It can be initiated by your person using the KKiaPay dashboard or by your customer using your web or mobile application.

### Transaction initiated by the client&#x20;

The most common transaction is the one initiated by your customer using your web or mobile application. The latter communicates with KKiaPay via our widget which offers him the possibility to initiate and finalize a payment process.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZZ44EjyWXy1_geVWm-%2F-LZZ48187zvyZLILS5ZC%2FRectangle22.png?alt=media\&token=266f4e15-9adf-436b-8e4e-0b5f67c80193)

### Transaction initiated by the merchant

For one reason or another, you may be led as a merchant to initiate a transaction for a customer. In this case, you will use your KKiaPay dashboard.&#x20;

Note that such a transaction can only be carried out based on the payment method that is mobile money (MTN Mobile money or Flooz money).

### Cancelling a transaction

The KKiaPay dashboard provides you with a list of the various transactions made by your customers and involving you. If for any reason you decide as a merchant to cancel a customer transaction you will need to access the "**Transactions"** menu and initiate the transaction.


# Prestashop

The prestashop KKiaPay plugin is designed to allow the integration of KkiaPay on your pr

Downloadable [here](https://github.com/kkiapay/files/blob/master/kkiapay-prestashop.zip?raw=true) the KKiaPay Prestashop plugin can be used on your e-commerce site when it is designed from Prestashop. When installed and active, it is easily identifiable among your extensions.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LggCkyw2aRZXPy5WlCX%2F-LggOK7UM7khCX0TbN6i%2FGroup.png?alt=media\&token=96a3301e-207d-4418-a86b-b39a0e273319)

In order to configure it you can either access the "**Configure**" option of the Prestashop plugin of your KKiaPay plugin or access the "**Module Manager**" menu. You will then see the interface below which shows you the list of the different Prestashop plugins installed and more precisely KKiaPay.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LggCkyw2aRZXPy5WlCX%2F-LggQ9OFzgoPddEhV6Yh%2FGroup%202.png?alt=media\&token=1a9c77f4-69ed-4c68-9563-cb9840614392)

Then configure the KKiaPay plugin by clicking on the "**Configure**" tab and entering a certain amount of information, including your API keys. Retrieve these directly from your KKiaPay dashboard (**Developers > API Keys**) note that the public key is the most important.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LggCkyw2aRZXPy5WlCX%2F-LggS1IEPQIh8aSDUFTR%2FGroup%203.png?alt=media\&token=0b0999e7-f775-449d-9e63-1ca31a2f926e)

{% hint style="info" %}
If you are in test mode with [KKiaPay Sandbox](/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/kkiapay-sandbox-guide-de-test), you must activate the test mode when configuring the KKiaPay plugin. In this case, you can use the [test phone numbers](/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/kkiapay-sandbox-guide-de-test#numeros-de-telephone-de-test) offered by KKiaPay to get an idea of the KKiaPay live environment you will find here.
{% endhint %}

Configure your preferences and click on **Save**. You can then use KKiaPay to receive payments from your customers.

## An online payment with the prestashop plugin of KKiaPay

Your customer will have to specify the payment method he wants to use in order to validate his paner. On the order page, he will find a list of the various payment methods available on your website. His choice will then have to be made in favour of KKiaPay. He will then have to place an order by clicking on "**ORDER WITH OBLIGATION OF PAYMENT**".

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LggCkyw2aRZXPy5WlCX%2F-LggT5ZM1wf3xIn3qwhk%2FGroup%204.png?alt=media\&token=12d269a7-8a44-4dc8-bed0-04bcdedc57e1)

KKiaPay injects a button on its payment path dedicated to the execution of its "**CONFIRM**" transaction:

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LggCkyw2aRZXPy5WlCX%2F-LggUEU1J8OiCtBzmT6x%2FGroup%205.png?alt=media\&token=4ada1c9e-407c-4198-8f34-1c2b13e5e10a)

To finalize the payment, the customer will have to click on the "**Pay**" button and receive a message from his telephone operator asking him to confirm the debit transaction. The customer's account is then debited and KKiaPay, which is informed, notifies the customer of the success of its transaction.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LggCkyw2aRZXPy5WlCX%2F-LggKc40ndSJ9oi9bgZU%2FCapture%20d%E2%80%99%C3%A9cran%20de%202019-06-05%2013-23-55.png?alt=media\&token=70240fe7-11f7-455e-a087-45bddc187caf)

A notification will then appear indicating that the transaction has been successful.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LggCkyw2aRZXPy5WlCX%2F-LggKNRMZi3e8XmeIUOe%2FCapture%20d%E2%80%99%C3%A9cran%20de%202019-06-05%2014-32-20.png?alt=media\&token=05ba23ea-ce08-4464-8960-4dbdcb5c6bbb)


# WooCommerce

The WooCommerce plugin is designed to allow the integration of KKiaPay on your WordPress site.

Downloadable [here](https://github.com/kkiapay/wordpress-plugin/blob/master/kkiapay-woocommerce.zip?raw=true) or available directly from your WordPress dashboard, the KKiaPay WooCommerce plugin is usable for your e-commerce site when it is designed from WordPress. When installed and active, it is easily identifiable among your extensions.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZtzlsJgZaHzi5e6kNP%2F-LZu_gnympwcmfjnDGqE%2Fplug1.png?alt=media\&token=94b6b4e3-4b52-426b-833c-11a0ee2b618e)

In order to configure it you can either access the "**Settings**" tab of the WooCommerce plugin or the "**Settings**" tab of your KKiaPay plugin. Then click on the "**Payments**" tab. You will then see the interface below which shows you the list of the different WooCommerce plugins installed.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZtzlsJgZaHzi5e6kNP%2F-LZu_gp-59SCUczAIEUf%2Fplug2.png?alt=media\&token=402ddd79-4816-40cc-840e-fa0de662e92b)

Then configure the KKiaPay plugin by clicking on the "**Manage**" tab and entering a certain amount of information, including your API keys. Retrieve these directly from your KKiaPay dashboard (**Developers > API Keys**).

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZtzlsJgZaHzi5e6kNP%2F-LZu_gp5jmHxd1hSErG_%2Fplug3.png?alt=media\&token=069c705d-4125-44f1-b52e-1bf3ec3f07fc)

{% endhint %}

Configure your preferences and click **Save**. You can then use KKiaPay to receive payments from your customers.

# Wordpress Give

The kkiapay-give plugin is designed to allow the integration of KKiaPay with the Give extension on your wordpress site

The kkiapay-give plugin is currently compatible with the latest version of Give. To download it, click [here](https://github.com/kkiapay/files/blob/master/kkiapay-give-v2.zip?raw=true).\
If your application is running an older version of Give (prior to Give v3), click [here](https://github.com/kkiapay/files/blob/master/kkiapay-give.zip?raw=true) to download it.

Once you install and activate KkiaPay-Give, you’ll easily find it among your extensions.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlWGYp_xeWqyVZLP_Xx%2F-LlWNpAjzwKJ8fNKb1_J%2FGroup%207.png?alt=media\&token=eeced8af-0f33-4aba-89c9-db8320b11b12)

In order to configure it you must access the "**Settings**" tab of your Give plugin. You will then see the interface below which shows you the list of the different Give plugins installed.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlWGYp_xeWqyVZLP_Xx%2F-LlWOIuKTo2ZM-bLwI-9%2FPlugin%20activ%C3%A9.png?alt=media\&token=c7ddcd56-7ba1-4426-b980-b6759f774483)

If you want to evolve in test mode with KKiaPay Sandbox, you must put the Give plugin in test mode when configuring it in the settings section and then choose the "**General**" tab. In this case, you can use the [test phone numbers](/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/kkiapay-sandbox-guide-de-test#test-phone-numbers) offered by KKiaPay to get an idea of the KKiaPay test environment.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlWGYp_xeWqyVZLP_Xx%2F-LlWQbKGevhAKU_pbuIm%2FGroup%208.png?alt=media\&token=c0bcf0a3-82c5-4b5c-b8fe-8fb54dc98976)

### An online donation with the kkiapay-give plugin

In order to make a donation, your donor must specify the payment method he wishes to use. His choice will then have to be made in favour of KKiaPay.&#x20;

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlWGYp_xeWqyVZLP_Xx%2F-LlWTPhsqp7YDs0oj3v4%2FGroup%209.png?alt=media\&token=c48217bf-27ff-48fd-99e1-d4a403a4d0cb)

To finalize the donation, the customer will have to click on the "Pay" button and will then receive a message from his telephone operator asking him to confirm the debit transaction. The customer's account is then debited and KKiaPay, which is informed, notifies the customer of the success of its transaction.&#x20;

You can then go to the "Donate" menu on your WordPress dashboard to check the status of the transaction.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlWGYp_xeWqyVZLP_Xx%2F-LlWQgXtzRh3cVmUGXHI%2Fok4.png?alt=media\&token=3283c113-bd37-4024-afea-869082cec0dd)

# Javascript SDK

The Javascript SDK is designed to allow the integration of KKiaPay into your web application.

{% hint style="info" %}
Whatever technology you use to create your web application, the Javascript SDK can be used. Its integration is done in two (02) steps:

* [ ] Integration of the Javascript SDK on the client side to initiate the payment transaction.
* [ ] Verification of the transaction using the [server SDK](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side) associated with your technology
  {% endhint %}

Any use of the KKiaPay SDK requires a valid merchant account. If you don't have one yet, [create one now](/v1/en-1.0.0/accueil/kkiapay). The integration of the KKiaPay SDK is done by importing the following script before closing the closing tag`</body>` :

```markup
<script src="https://cdn.kkiapay.me/k.js"></script>
```

Once the SDK is imported into your web application you can use it in various ways, namely:

* With a WebComponent ( HTML tag)&#x20;
* By adding a CSS class on your `Pay` button
* By calling the payment from your Javascript code

{% hint style="info" %}
If you are in test mode with [KKiaPay Sandbox](/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/kkiapay-sandbox-guide-de-test), you must activate the test mode when configuring the KKiaPay plugin. In this case, you can use the [test phone numbers](/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/kkiapay-sandbox-guide-de-test#numeros-de-telephone-de-test) offered by KKiaPay to get an idea of the KKiaPay live environment.
{% endhint %}

1. **The WebComponent method**&#x20;

Just add the code below in your code to the desired location for your `Pay`button

{% hint style="warning" %}
Replace the values of the attributes amount, key, url and callback with the appropriate values
{% endhint %}

```markup
<kkiapay-widget amount="<amount-to-be-deducted>" 
                key="<your-api-key>"
                url="<url-to-your-logo>"
                position="center"
                sandbox="true"
                callback="<url-of-redirection-when-the-payment-is-a-success>">
</kkiapay-widget>
```

{% hint style="info" %}
You've the choice !&#x20;

Do you want to allow only one payment method (Credit Card or Mobile Money) on your KKiaPay interface ? The ***paymentmethod*** attribute allows you to do so.&#x20;

The value ***momo*** of this attribute authorizes the payment via Mobile Money, as the only payment method on the KKiaPay widget, and its value *card* the payment via Credit Card.
{% endhint %}

<div align="left"><img src="https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZzZWBazscnhks1RRj5%2F-LZzaMO3QsfFdxzd0YXM%2Flatif.png?alt=media&amp;token=972b53a4-ccdb-4193-a73e-3f1e880ff7eb" alt=""></div>

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZyk5nvy9wwrope4-BH%2F-LZyl6t1W2qg05unwr8T%2FCapture%20d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran%202019-03-02%20a%CC%80%2015.17.12.png?alt=media\&token=5daa929c-9ed4-4d95-989b-dfe75e846f37)

{% hint style="info" %}
Already have a *Pay* button? The method using the CSS class is the one that suits you best.
{% endhint %}

**2. Method** **based on the CSS class**

It requires the modification of the script imported into your page. Add the necessary information to it using the snippet below as an example :

```markup
<script amount="<amount-to-be-deducted>" 
        callback=""
        url="<url-to-your-logo>"
        position="right" 
        theme="#0095ff"
        sandbox="true"
        key="<your-api-key>"
        src="https://cdn.kkiapay.me/k.js"></script>
```

Then add the **kkiapay-button** class on your html button.

```markup
<button class="kkiapay-button"></button>
```

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LZzS5UsBjbbw-b82z8h%2F-LZzX509rdLx3u9yk3wg%2FCapture%20d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran%202019-03-02%20a%CC%80%2018.51.02.png?alt=media\&token=7ad3964c-2c6d-488e-a222-4fc1532656e0)

{% hint style="info" %}
You can change the position of the kkiapay widget by changing the value of the attribut&#x65;**`position = right|left|center`**
{% endhint %}

**3. From your Javascript code**

Once the script is imported into your code, the **openKkiapayWidget** function is automatically available in the DOM. You can therefore open the payment window by using the following function :

```javascript
openKkiapayWidget({amount:"1",position:"right",callback:"",
                  theme:"green",
                  key:"<your-api-key>"})
```

{% hint style="danger" %}
**Important !**&#x20;

To avoid fraud, check the server side of the transaction transaction. To do this, learn more about [Server SDKs](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side).
{% endhint %}

You can subscribe to the events related to the payment transaction with the addSuccessListener function

```javascript
   addSuccessListener(response => {
        console.log(response);
    });
```

### Reference

| Attribute     | Type    | Required | Description                                                                       |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| partnerId     | String  | No       | Your unique identifier, for the transaction                                       |
| data          | -       | No       | The information related to your transaction                                       |
| phone         | String  | No       | Customer's telephone number (if mobile money)                                     |
| paymentmethod | -       | No       | The payment method to be authorized on the KKiaPay widget: momo \| card \| wallet |
| countries     | array   | No       | Countries from which you accept payments: BJ\|CI\|TG\|SN\|NE                      |
| name          | String  | No       | Surname and first names of the customer                                           |
| email         | String  | No       | customer's email                                                                  |
| theme         | String  | No       | The color you want for the KKiaPay widget                                         |
| key           | String  | Yes      | Your public API key                                                               |
| callback      | String  | Non      | The redirection link at the end of the payment                                    |
| position      | String  | No       | The position of your widget on your site: left \| right \| center                 |
| amount        | Numeric | Yes      | The amount debited to the customer                                                |
| sandbox       | Boolean | No       | The ***true*** value of this attribute allows you to switch to test mode          |

### Response

The answer obtained is a Javascript object containing the transaction ID.


# Frameworks

We provide plugins that make it easy to integrate KKiaPay into several JavaScript frameworks.

Currently, plugins are available for :

* Vue.js
* Nuxt.js
* React.js
* Next.js
* Angular
* Svelte


# Using KKiaPay with Vue.js

### Installation

Please run the following command :

```bash
npm install kkiapay@latest
```

### Import

You can now import the kkiapay dependency into your page :

```js
import {
  openKkiapayWidget,
  addKkiapayListener,
  removeKkiapayListener,
} from "kkiapay";
```

### Usage

Define a function that will display the KKiaPay Widget :&#x20;

```javascript
export default {
  methods: {
    open() {
      openKkiapayWidget({
        amount: 4000,
        api_key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
        sandbox: true,
        phone: "97000000",
      });
    },
  },
};
```

You can now use this function within your view template to display the payment interface :

```javascript
<template>
  <div class="home">
    <button @click="open">click me</button>
  </div>
</template>vue
```

{% hint style="danger" %}
**Important !**&#x20;

To avoid fraud, perform the server-side verification of the transaction operation. Learn more about the [Admin SDKs (Server-Side)](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side).
{% endhint %}

You can subscribe to payment transaction events with the **addKkiapayListener** function. To be notified of the successful status of a payment transaction, you can proceed as follows :

```javascript
export default {
  // ... others options
  methods: {
    // ... others functions
    successHandler(response) {
      console.log(response);
    },
  },
  
  mounted() {
    addKkiapayListener('success',this.successHandler)
  },
};
```

Because it is added in the mounted hook, the addKkiapayListener function will be called each time your component is rendered. If the component is returned n times, the function will be enrolled n times.&#x20;

In order to avoid memory leaks, we will need to delete the callback when the component is destroyed :

```javascript
export default {
  // ... others options
  methods: {
    // ... others functions
    successHandler(response) {
      console.log(response);
    },
  },
  
  mounted() {
    addKkiapayListener('success',this.successHandler)
  },
  
  // ....
  beforeDestroy() {
      removeKkiapayListener('success',this.successHandler)
  },
};
```


# Using KKiaPay with Nuxt.js

### Installation

Please run the following command :

```shell
npm install kkiapay@latest
```

### Add kkiapay plugin

```typescript
// plugins/kkiapay.client.ts

import { defineNuxtPlugin } from "#app";
import * as kkiapayModule from "kkiapay";

export default defineNuxtPlugin(() => {
  return {
    provide: {
      kkiapay: kkiapayModule,
    },
  };
});
```

### Usage

Define a function that will display the KKiaPay Widget :&#x20;

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ListenerData } from "kkiapay";

const { $kkiapay } = useNuxtApp();

const initPayment = () => {
  $kkiapay.openKkiapayWidget({
    amount: 100,
    sandbox: true,
    key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
    phone: "22997000000",
  });
};
</script>
```

You can now use this function within your view template to display the payment interface :

```vue-html
<template>
  <div>
    <button @click="open">click me</button>
  </div>
</template>vue
```

{% hint style="danger" %}
**Important !**&#x20;

To avoid fraud, perform the server-side verification of the transaction operation. Learn more about the [Admin SDKs (Server-Side)](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side).
{% endhint %}

You can subscribe to payment transaction events with the **addKkiapayListener** function and proceed as follows :

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
// ... autres options

const onPaymentSuccess = (response: ListenerData) => {
  console.log("Paiement Réussi:", response);
};

const onPaymentFailed = (response: ListenerData) => {
  console.log("Paiement Échoué:", response);
};

const initPayment = () => {
  // Pour être notifié du statut réussi de l'opération de paiement
  $kkiapay.addKkiapayListener("success", onPaymentSuccess);
  
  // Pour être notifié du statut échec de l'opération de paiement
  $kkiapay.addKkiapayListener("failed", onPaymentFailed);

  $kkiapay.openKkiapayWidget({
    amount: 100,
    sandbox: true,
    key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
    phone: "22997000000",
  });
};
</script>
```

In order to avoid memory leaks, we will need to delete the callback when the component is destroyed :

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

// ... code précédent

  onUnmounted(() => {
    $kkiapay.removeKkiapayListener("success");
  });
</script>
```


# Using KKiaPay with React.js

### Installation

Please run the following command :

```bash
npm install kkiapay-react
```

### Import

You can now import the kkiapay dependency into your page :

```javascript
import { useKKiaPay } from 'kkiapay-react';
```

### Usage

Define a function that will display the KKiaPay Widget :&#x20;

<pre class="language-javascript"><code class="lang-javascript"><strong>function Home() {
</strong>  function open() {
    openKkiapayWidget({
      amount: 4000,
      api_key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
      sandbox: true,
      email: "randomgail@gmail.com",
      phone: "97000000",
    });
  }

  return (
    &#x3C;div>
      &#x3C;button onClick={open}>click me&#x3C;/button>
    &#x3C;/div>
  );
}
</code></pre>

{% hint style="danger" %}
**Important !**&#x20;

To avoid fraud, perform the server-side verification of the transaction operation. Learn more about the [Admin SDKs (Server-Side)](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side).
{% endhint %}

You can subscribe to payment transaction events with the **addKkiapayListener** function and proceed as follows :

```jsx
function Home() {
  const { openKkiapayWidget, addKkiapayListener } = useKKiaPay();

  // ..... others components options
  function successHandler(response) {
    console.log(response);
  }
  
  function failureHandler(error) {
    console.log(error);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    addKkiapayListener('success', successHandler)
    addKkiapayListener('failed', failureHandler)
  }, [addKkiapayListener]);

  // ..... others components options
}
```

Because it is added in the useEffect hook, the addKkiapayListener function will be called each time your component is rendered. If the component is returned n times, the function will be enrolled n times.&#x20;

In order to avoid memory leaks, we will need to delete the callback when the component is destroyed :

```jsx
function Home() {
  const { 
    openKkiapayWidget,
    addKkiapayListener,
    removeKkiapayListener
  } = useKKiaPay();

  // ..... others components options
  function successHandler(response) {
    console.log(response);
  }
    
  function failureHandler(error) {
    console.log(error);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    addKkiapayListener('success',successHandler)
    addKkiapayListener('failed', failureHandler)
    
    return () => {
      removeKkiapayListener('success',successHandler)
      removeKkiapayListener('failed', failureHandler)
    };
  }, [addKkiapayListener,removeKkiapayListener]);
  // ..... others components options
}
```

    &#x3C;div>

To avoid fraud, perform the server-side verification of the transaction operation. Learn more about the [Admin SDKs (Server-Side)](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side).
{% endhint %}

You can subscribe to payment transaction events with the **addKkiapayListener** function and proceed as follows :

```jsx
function Home() {

  // ..... others components options

    console.log(response);

    console.log(error);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    addKkiapayListener('success', successHandler)
    addKkiapayListener('failed', failureHandler)

  // ..... others components options
}
```

Because it is added in the useEffect hook, the addKkiapayListener function will be called each time your component is rendered. If the component is returned n times, the function will be enrolled n times.&#x20;

In order to avoid memory leaks, we will need to delete the callback when the component is destroyed :

```jsx
function Home() {
  const { 
    openKkiapayWidget,
    addKkiapayListener,
    removeKkiapayListener

  // ..... others components options
  function successHandler(response) {
    console.log(response);
  }

    console.log(error);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    addKkiapayListener('success',successHandler)
    addKkiapayListener('failed', failureHandler)
    
    return () => {
      removeKkiapayListener('success',successHandler)
      removeKkiapayListener('failed', failureHandler)
```
