

# Using KKiaPay with Angular

### Installation

Please run the following command :

```shell
npm install kkiapay@latest
```

### Importation&#x20;

You can now import the kkiapay dependency into your page :

```javascript
import {
  openKkiapayWidget,
  addKkiapayListener,
  removeKkiapayListener,
} from "kkiapay";
```

### Usage

Define a function that will display the KKiaPay Widget :&#x20;

```javascript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { openKkiapayWidget, addKkiapayListener,removeKkiapayListener  } from 'kkiapay'
​
@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  templateUrl: './app.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./app.component.css']
})

export class AppComponent {
  title = 'kkiapay-sample-project';
​
  open() {
    openKkiapayWidget({
      amount: 1000,
      api_key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
      sandbox: true,
      phone: "97000000",
    })
  }  
}
```

You can now use this function in your template to open the payment window :

```html
<div>
    <button (click)="open()">
        Payer Maintenant
    </button>
</div>
```

{% hint style="danger" %}
**Important !**&#x20;

To avoid fraud, perform the server-side verification of the transaction operation. Learn more about the [Admin SDKs (Server-Side)](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side).
{% endhint %}

You can subscribe to payment transaction events with the **addKkiapayListener** function. To be notified of the successful status of a payment transaction, you can proceed as follows :

```javascript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { openKkiapayWidget, addKkiapayListener,removeKkiapayListener  } from 'kkiapay'
​
@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  templateUrl: './app.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./app.component.css']
})

export class AppComponent {
  title = 'kkiapay-sample-project';
​
  open() {
    openKkiapayWidget({
      amount: 1000,
      api_key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
      sandbox: true,
      phone: "97000000",
    })
  }  
​
  successHandler() {
    console.log("payment success...");
  }
​
  ngOnInit() {
    addKkiapayListener('success',this.successHandler)
  }
}
```

Because it is added in the mounted hook, the addKkiapayListener function will be called each time your component is rendered. If the component is returned n times, the function will be enrolled n times.&#x20;

In order to avoid memory leaks, we will need to delete the callback when the component is destroyed :

```javascript
​
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { openKkiapayWidget, addKkiapayListener,removeKkiapayListener  } from 'kkiapay'
​
@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  templateUrl: './app.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./app.component.css']
})

export class AppComponent {
  title = 'sample-project-angular';
​
  open() {
    openKkiapayWidget({
      amount: 1000,
      api_key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
      sandbox: true,
      phone: "97000000",
    })
  }
​
  successHandler() {
    console.log("payment success...");
  }
​
  ngOnInit() {
    addKkiapayListener('success',this.successHandler)
  }
​
  ngOnDestroy(){
    removeKkiapayListener('success',this.successHandler)
  }
}
```


# Using KKiaPay with Svelte

### Installation

Please run the following command :

```shell
npm install kkiapay@latest
```

### Importation&#x20;

You can now import the kkiapay dependency into your page :

```javascript
import {
  openKkiapayWidget,
  addKkiapayListener,
  removeKkiapayListener,
} from "kkiapay";
```

### Usage

Define a function that will display the KKiaPay Widget :&#x20;

```javascript
<script>
  import {
    openKkiapayWidget,
    removeKkiapayListener,
    addKkiapayListener,
  } from "kkiapay";

  function open() {
    openKkiapayWidget({
      amount: 1000,
      api_key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
      sandbox: true,
      phone: "97000000",
    });
  }
</script>
```

You can now use this function in your template to open the payment window :

```html
<main>
  <button on:click={open}> Pay now </button>
</main>
```

{% hint style="danger" %}
**Important !**&#x20;

To avoid fraud, perform the server-side verification of the transaction operation. Learn more about the [Admin SDKs (Server-Side)](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side).
{% endhint %}

You can subscribe to payment transaction events with the **addKkiapayListener** function. To be notified of the successful status of a payment transaction, you can proceed as follows :

```javascript
<script>
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from "svelte";
  import {
    openKkiapayWidget,
    removeKkiapayListener,
    addKkiapayListener,
  } from "kkiapay";

  function successHandler() {
    console.log("payment success...");
  }

  onMount(() => {
    addKkiapayListener("success", successHandler);
    console.log("the component has mounted");
  });
</script>
```

Because it is added in the mounted hook, the addKkiapayListener function will be called each time your component is rendered. If the component is returned n times, the function will be enrolled n times.&#x20;

In order to avoid memory leaks, we will need to delete the callback when the component is destroyed :

```javascript
​<script>
  //... others options
  onDestroy(() => {
    removeKkiapayListener("success", successHandler);
  });
</script>
```


# Android SDK

The Android SDK is designed to allow the integration of KKiaPay into your mobile application.

### Installation

1. Add the following line in your root `settings.gradle` file inside `repositories` of `dependencyResolutionManagement` section

```gradle
maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' }
```

2. Add the following line in your app's `build.gradle` file inside `dependencies` section

```gradle
implementation 'com.github.kkiapay:android-sdk:<latestVersion>'
```

### Usage&#x20;

Get your API Key on [kkiapay Dashboard at Developer section](https://app.kkiapay.me/dashboard/developers/keys) and initialize the Sdk in your Application Class

#### Initiate the API

In the onCreate method of your Application class :

```javascript
import co.opensi.kkiapay.uikit.Kkiapay
import co.opensi.kkiapay.uikit.SdkConfig

Kkiapay.init(applicationContext,
    "<kkiapay-api-key>",
    SdkConfig(themeColor = R.color.colorPrimary,
        /* set enableSandbox = false in case you are using live API Keys */
        enableSandbox = true )
)
```

### Example

```gradle
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import co.opensi.kkiapay.uikit.Kkiapay
```

```gradle
class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)
    }

    override fun onStart() {
        super.onStart()

        // Setup listener for payment status
        Kkiapay.get().setListener { status, transactionId ->
            //The following code will be run when user will end the payment
            Toast.makeText(
                this@MainActivity,
                "Transaction: ${status.name} -> $transactionId",
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show()
        }
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        val testButtonWithKkiapay = findViewById<Button>(R.id.test_button_with_kkiapay)
        testButtonWithKkiapay.setOnClickListener {
            // start the payment process
            // This will display a kkiapay payment dialog to user
            Kkiapay.get().requestPayment(
                this,
                1,
                reason = "Payment of awesome service",
                api_key = "<kkiapay-api-key>",
                sandbox = false,
                name = "Johna DOE",
                partnerId = "AxXxxXXid",
                phone = "22961877882",
                email = "email@mail.com",
                paymentMethods = listOf("momo", "card", "direct_debit"),
            )
        }
    }

    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
        Kkiapay.get().handleActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
    }

}
```

### Reference

<table data-header-hidden><thead><tr><th width="236">Attribut</th><th width="138">Type</th><th width="94">Requis</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>api_key</td><td>String</td><td>Yes</td><td>public api key</td></tr><tr><td>amount</td><td>Number</td><td>Yes</td><td>Amount to debit from user account (XOF)</td></tr><tr><td>phone</td><td>String</td><td>Yes</td><td>Valid mobile money number to debit. ex : 22967434270</td></tr><tr><td>name</td><td>String</td><td>No</td><td>Client firstname and lastname</td></tr><tr><td>email</td><td>String</td><td>No</td><td>Client email</td></tr><tr><td>partnerId</td><td>String</td><td>No</td><td>Your id to find transaction</td></tr><tr><td>paymentMethods</td><td>Array of string</td><td>No</td><td>Set widget payment methods ex: ["momo","card"]</td></tr><tr><td>sandbox</td><td>Boolean</td><td>No</td><td>The <em><strong>true</strong></em> value of this attribute allows you to switch to test modet</td></tr><tr><td>reason</td><td>String</td><td>No</td><td>Reason of transaction</td></tr></tbody></table>


# SDK Flutter

This SDK is designed to allow the integration of KKiaPay into your Flutter mobile application. To set it up you will need to [create an account](/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/creation-dun-compte) on [kkiapay.me](/v1/en-1.0.0/accueil/kkiapay) platform and follow the process here describes :&#x20;

### Installation

To use this package :

```gradle
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  kkiapay_flutter_sdk:
```

For web

```html
add to your index.html
<script src="https://cdn.kkiapay.me/k.js"></script>
```

### Usage

```dart
import 'package:kkiapay_flutter_sdk/kkiapay_flutter_sdk.dart';
```

**Initialise the Kkiapay Instance**

```dart
final kkiapay = KKiaPay(
    @required callback: Function(Map<String, dynamic> response, BuildContext context),
    @required amount: int, // Ex : 1000
    @required apikey: String, // Ex : XXXX_public_api_key_XXX
    @required sandbox: bool, // Ex : true
    data: String, // Ex : 'Big data'
    phone: String, // Ex : "22961000000"
    name: String, // Ex : "John Doe"
    reason: String, // Ex : "transaction reason"
    email: String, // Ex : "email@mail.com"
    callbackUrl: String, // Ex : "http://kkiapay.me"
    theme: String, // Ex : "#222F5A"
    countries: List<String>, // Ex :  ["CI","BJ"]
    partnerId: String, // Ex : 'AxXxXXxId'
    paymentMethods: List<String> // Ex : ["momo","card"]
);
```

**Create payment webview instance**

Mobile:

```dart
Navigator.push( context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => kkiapay), );
```

Web:

```dart
KkiapayFlutterSdkPlatform.instance.pay( kkiapay, context, callback );
```

### Example

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:kkiapay_flutter_sdk/kkiapay_flutter_sdk.dart';


void main() => runApp(App());

void callback(response, context) {
  switch ( response['status'] ) {

    case PAYMENT_CANCELLED:
      Navigator.pop(context);
      debugPrint(PAYMENT_CANCELLED);
    break;

    case PAYMENT_INIT:
      debugPrint(PAYMENT_INIT);
      break;

    case PENDING_PAYMENT:
      debugPrint(PENDING_PAYMENT);
      break;
      
    case PAYMENT_SUCCESS:
      Navigator.pop(context);
      Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => SuccessScreen(
            amount: response['requestData']['amount'],
            transactionId: response['transactionId'],
          ),
        ),
      );
      break;

    default:
      debugPrint(UNKNOWN_EVENT);
      break;
  }
}

final kkiapay = KKiaPay(
    amount: 1000,//
    countries: ["BJ","CI","SN","TG"],//
    phone: "22961000000",//
    name: "John Doe",//
    email: "email@mail.com",//
    reason: 'Transaction reason',//
    data: 'Fake data',//
    sandbox: true,//
    apikey: public_api_key,//
    callback: callback,//
    theme: defaultTheme, // Ex : "#222F5A",
    partnerId: 'AxXxXXxId',//
    paymentMethods: ["momo","card"]//
);

class App extends StatelessWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      home: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          backgroundColor: nColorPrimary,
          title: Text('Kkiapay Sample'),
          centerTitle: true,
        ),
        body: KkiapaySample(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class KkiapaySample extends StatelessWidget {
  const KkiapaySample({
    Key? key,
  }) : super(key: key);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Center(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            ButtonTheme(
              minWidth: 500.0,
              height: 100.0,
              child: TextButton(
                style: ButtonStyle(
                  backgroundColor: MaterialStateProperty.all(Color(0xff222F5A)),
                  foregroundColor: MaterialStateProperty.all(Colors.white),
                ),
                child: const Text(
                  'Pay Now',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
                ),
                onPressed: () {
                  Navigator.push(
                    context,
                    MaterialPageRoute(builder: (context) => kkiapay),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 50,),
            ButtonTheme(
              minWidth: 500.0,
              height: 100.0,
              child: TextButton(
                style: ButtonStyle(
                  backgroundColor:
                  MaterialStateProperty.all(const Color(0xff222F5A)),
                  foregroundColor: MaterialStateProperty.all(Colors.white),
                ),
                child: const Text(
                  'Pay Now ( WEB )',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
                ),
                onPressed: () {
                  KkiapayFlutterSdkPlatform.instance.pay(kkiapay, context, callback);
                },
              ),
            )
          ],
        )
    );
  }
}
```

### Reference

<table><thead><tr><th>Argument</th><th width="137">Type</th><th width="114">Required</th><th>Details</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>phone</td><td>String</td><td>Yes</td><td>Valid mobile money number to debit. ex : 22967434270</td></tr><tr><td>amount</td><td>Numeric</td><td>Yes</td><td>Amount to debit from user account (XOF)</td></tr><tr><td>name</td><td>String</td><td>No</td><td>Client firstname and lastname</td></tr><tr><td>partnerId</td><td>String</td><td>No</td><td>Your id to find transaction</td></tr><tr><td>countries</td><td>List of String</td><td>No</td><td>Set widget countries ex: ["CI"]</td></tr><tr><td>paymentMethods</td><td>List of String</td><td>No</td><td>Set widget payment methods ex: ["momo","card"]</td></tr><tr><td>theme</td><td>String</td><td>No</td><td>the hexadecimal code of the color you want to give to your widget</td></tr><tr><td>apikey</td><td>String</td><td>Yes</td><td>public api key</td></tr><tr><td>sandbox</td><td>Boolean</td><td>No</td><td>The true value of this attribute allows you to switch to test mode</td></tr><tr><td>successCallback</td><td>Function</td><td>Yes</td><td>This function is called once the payment has been successfully made</td></tr></tbody></table>

```dart
the successCallback function takes two parameters in the following order
- Map<String,dynamic> containing the transaction information
  { 
    'requestData': {
      'amount': int,
      'phone': String,
      'reason': String,
      'data': String,
      'partnerId': String,
      'sandbox': bool,
      'name': String,
      'email': String
    },
    'transactionId': String, 
    'status': String 
  }
  
- the context of type BuildContext
```

{% hint style="info" %}
For more informations on the SDK please follow the link below : [KKiaPay Flutter SDK](< https://pub.dev/packages/kkiapay_flutter_sdk>).
{% endhint %}


# SDK React-Native

## Installation

```groovy
npx expo install react-native-webview
npm install @kkiapay-org/react-native-sdk
```

## Usage

1. Import KKiaPay provider to access all context's features

```groovy
// In your app file -- App
import { KkiapayProvider } from '@kkiapay-org/react-native-sdk';

import TestComponent from './TestComponent';

export default function App() {
  return (
    <KkiapayProvider>
      <TestComponent />
    </KkiapayProvider>
  );
}
```

2. Use the **useKkiapay** hook and get all available functions

```groovy
// In your component -- TestComponent
import { useKkiapay } from '@kkiapay-org/react-native-sdk';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Button, View } from 'react-native';

export default function TestComponent() {
  const { openKkiapayWidget, addSuccessListener, addFailedListener } = useKkiapay();

  useEffect(() => {
    addSuccessListener(data => {
      console.log('data ', data);
    });
    
    addFailedListener(data => {
      console.log('data ', data);
    });
  }, []);

  const openWidget = () => {
    openKkiapayWidget({
      amount: 4000,
      api_key: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
      sandbox: true,
      email: "randomgail@gmail.com",
      phone: "97000000",
    });
  };

  return (
    <View>
      <Button title="Pay now" onPress={openWidget} />
    </View>
  );
}
```


# SDK Swift for iOS

The KKiaPay SDK for Swift is designed to make the integration of our plugin into your mobile application as easy as possible. To set it up you will need to [create an account](/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/creation-dun-compte) on [kkiapay.me](/v1/en-1.0.0/accueil/kkiapay) platform and follow the process here describes :&#x20;

* **Add the KKiaPay Swift SDK to your application**

You can add the KKiaPay Swift SDK to your project using the Swift package manager.

{% hint style="info" %}
Practical guide for installing a package with Swift : [Installing a package](https://github.com/apple/swift-package-manager/tree/main/Documentation).
{% endhint %}

* **Import the package KKiaPay**

```swift
 import KKiaPaySDK;
```

* **Create a view model to use later**

```swift
@ObservedObject var viewModel = KKiaPayViewModel()
```

* **Initialise the KKiaPay Instance**

```swift
 private var kkiaPay: KKiaPay{
    KKiaPay(amount: "3000",
            phone: "22997000000",
            data: "Hello world",
            publicAPIKey: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
            sandbox: true,//set this to false in production
            theme: "#4E6BFC",
            name: "John Doe",
            email:"user@email.com",
            callback: "https://redirect.kkiapay.com",
            viewModel:viewModel
    )
}
```

ParamètresTypeDescriptionLe montant à payer en FCFAStringUn numéro mobile money valideLa donnée ou information liée à une transaction et interprétable par votre systèmeStringLa [clé publique](https://docs.kkiapay.me/v1/compte/untitled#recuperation-des-cles-de-lapi-kkiapay) liée à votre [compte KKiaPay](https://docs.kkiapay.me/v1/compte/creation-dun-compte)​StringLes nom et prénoms de l’initiateur du paiementStringL’adresse mail de l’initiateur du paiementVous permet de basculer de l'environnement de test à l'environnement de production. La valeur ***true*** de cet attribut signifie que vous êtes en [environnement de test](https://docs.kkiapay.me/v1/compte/kkiapay-sandbox-guide-de-test)​La fonction de callback appelée uniquement lorsque le paiement est effectué avec succès

<table><thead><tr><th width="210.7072125074535">Attribute</th><th width="150">Type</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>amount</td><td>Numeric</td><td>The amount to be paid (in XOF)</td></tr><tr><td>phone</td><td>String</td><td>A valid money mobile number (MTN or MOOV)<br>Ex: 22997000000<br>Ex: 22995000000</td></tr><tr><td>data</td><td>String</td><td>The data or information related to a transaction and interpretable by your system</td></tr><tr><td>publicAPIKey</td><td>String</td><td>The <a href="/v1/en-1.0.0/tableau-de-bord/untitled/menu-developpeurs#api-keys">public key</a> linked to your <a href="/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/creation-dun-compte">KKiaPay account</a></td></tr><tr><td>name</td><td>String</td><td>The first and last name of the initiator of the payment</td></tr><tr><td>email</td><td>String</td><td>The email address of the initiator of the payment</td></tr><tr><td>sandbox</td><td>Boolean</td><td>Allows you to switch from the <a href="/v1/en-1.0.0/compte/kkiapay-sandbox-guide-de-test">test environment</a> to the production environment. The value <em><strong>true</strong></em> for this attribute means that you are in a test environment</td></tr><tr><td>callback</td><td>Function</td><td>The callback function called only when the payment was successful</td></tr></tbody></table>

{% hint style="danger" %}
**Important !**&#x20;

To avoid fraud, perform the server-side verification of the transaction operation. Learn more about the [Admin SDKs (Server-Side)](/v1/en-1.0.0/plugin-et-sdk/admin-sdks-server-side).
{% endhint %}

You can subscribe to payment transaction events with the **onReceive** function. To be notified of the successful status of a payment transaction, you can proceed as follows :

```swift
kkiaPay.onReceive(self.viewModel.paymentData.receive(on: RunLoop.main)){paymentData in
    
    if(paymentData.isSuccessful){
        print("The amount of the transaction is " + paymentData.amount+" with id "+paymentData.transactionId)
        showWebView = false
    }else{
        print("The payment was not successful")
    }
}
```

### Example

```swift
import SwiftUI
import KKiaPaySDK

struct ContentView: View {
        //Create a view model instance to use later
        @ObservedObject var viewModel = KKiaPayViewModel()
        @State private var showWebView = false
        
        //Initialise the Kkiapay Instance
        private var kkiaPay: KKiaPay{
            KKiaPay(amount: "3000",
                    phone: "97000000",
                    data: "Hello world",
                    publicAPIKey: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
                    sandbox: true,//set this to false in production
                    theme: "#4E6BFC",
                    name: "John Doe",
                    email:"user@email.com",
                    callback: "https://redirect.kkiapay.com",
                    viewModel:viewModel
            )
        }
        
        var body: some View {
            Button {
                showWebView.toggle()
            } label: {
                Text("Pay")
            }
            .sheet(isPresented: $showWebView) {
                
                //Get the transaction data back 
                kkiaPay.onReceive(self.viewModel.paymentData.receive(on: RunLoop.main)){paymentData in
                    
                    if(paymentData.isSuccessful){
                        print("The amount of the transaction is " + paymentData.amount+" with id "+paymentData.transactionId)
                        showWebView = false
                    }else{
                        print("The payment was not successful")
                    }
                }
            }
        }
}

struct ContentView_Previews: PreviewProvider {
    static var previews: some View {
        ContentView()
    }
}
```

{% hint style="info" %}
For more informations on the SDK please follow the link below : [KKiaPay Swift SDK.](https://github.com/kkiapay/kkiapay-ios-sdk)
{% endhint %}


# Admin SDKs (Server-side)

The feature-rich server-based Admin SDK allows you to manage and configure your KKiaPay account. It can be used by you to keep an eye on your payment and refund transactions, track the status of your transactions and monitor your integration. Our Admin SDK, still under development, will simplify your understanding of our various features and will perfectly match your code. This SDK is available for the following technologies:&#x20;

* PHP
* Python
* Node.js


# PHP Admin SDK

To use the PHP version of the Admin SDK you must use this *composer* command:

```
composer require kkiapay/kkiapay-php:dev-master
```

## Initialization&#x20;

The use of the server Admin SDK requires the creation of a *kkiapay* object. In order to create that object, you will need to retrieve your API keys and to use the following commands whether you are in Sandbox mode or in production.

* In Sandbox

```php
$kkiapay = new \Kkiapay\Kkiapay($public_key,
                                $private_key, 
                                $secret, 
                                $sandbox = true);
```

{% hint style="info" %}
When the attribute `$sandbox` is set to ***true*** you're in test mode.
{% endhint %}

* In live

```php
$kkiapay = new \Kkiapay\Kkiapay($public_key,
                                $private_key, 
                                $secret);
```

## Status of a transaction

With the Server Admin SDK, you can retrieve all the information related to a transaction, using the reference of the operation that has been performed. To do this, you will need to fill in the following fields:&#x20;

* Your public, private and secret API keys
* The reference of the operation (see the image below)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LhkBRrLK51AmF-c6Vc2%2F-LhkBg3LnqA8lHNZqn1i%2FGroup%206.png?alt=media\&token=7e8f9cfa-42bc-4594-a435-63b23f6fb757)

### Example&#x20;

You can use the following code to test this feature:

```php
$kkiapay->verifyTransaction($transaction_id)

//response
Array(
    [performed_at] => 2025-04-10T15:01:49.499Z
    [type] => DEBIT
    [status] => SUCCESS
    [source] => MOBILE_MONEY
    [source_common_name] => mtn-benin
    [amount] => 40
    [fees] => 1
    [reason] => payment
    [failureCode] => 
    [failureMessage] => 
    [state] => null
    [partnerId] => 
    [feeSupportedBy] => customer
    [income] => 40
    [transactionId] => 0845058258857440
    [performedAt] => 10/04/2025
    [client] => Array
        (
            [fullname] => John Doe
            [phone] => 22997000000
            [email] => john.doe@gmail.com
        )
)
```

## **Refund a transaction**

Any ***success*** transaction made by mobile money can be subject to a refund operation. You have the possibility to make a refund if your customer hasn't obtained satisfaction for the service for which he paid or if you consider it necessary. In order to carry out such an operation, you will need to provide the following information:

* Your public, private and secret API keys
* The reference of the operation (see the image below)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LhkBRrLK51AmF-c6Vc2%2F-LhkBg3LnqA8lHNZqn1i%2FGroup%206.png?alt=media\&token=7e8f9cfa-42bc-4594-a435-63b23f6fb757)

{% hint style="info" %}
The refund of a transaction doesn't include the refund of the fees related to.
{% endhint %}

### Example&#x20;

You can use the following code to test this feature:

```php
$kkiapay->refundTransaction($transaction_id);
```


# Python Admin SDK

To install the Python Admin SDK you must follow the code below :

```python
#Initialize a virtual environment with python3 
python3 -m venv venv

#Install the SDK Admin
pip install kkiapay
```

## Status of a transaction

KKiaPay allow you to retrieve all the information related to a transaction. To do this, you will need to fill in the following fields:&#x20;

* Your public, private and secret API keys
* The reference of the operation (see the image below)

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LhkBRrLK51AmF-c6Vc2%2F-LhkBg3LnqA8lHNZqn1i%2FGroup%206.png?alt=media\&token=7e8f9cfa-42bc-4594-a435-63b23f6fb757)

### Example&#x20;

You can use the following code to test this feature :

```python
#Create an instance of KKiaPay
from kkiapay import Kkiapay
k = Kkiapay('public_key', 'private_key', 'secret', sandbox=True)

#Initialize the process of verification
transaction = k.verify_transaction('LVFNrK1nx')
#Where LVFNrK1nx is the reference of the transaction

print(transaction)

# => KkiapayTransaction(
#       performed_at='2019-07-11T11:24:42.687Z',
#       type='DEBIT',
#       status='FAILED',
#       source='MOBILE_MONEY',
#       amount=1,
#       fees=0,
#       country='BJ',
#       reason='invalid_number',
#       transactionId='LVFNrK1nx',
#       performedAt='07/11/2019'
#   )

print(transaction.status)
# => FAILED
print(transaction.amount)
# => 1
```

{% hint style="info" %}
Find [here](https://github.com/kkiapay/kkiapay-python) our source code initiated by the [PythonBenin community](https://github.com/PythonBenin) !
{% endhint %}

```javascript
const k = kkiapay({privatekey:"xxxxxxx",
```

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LhkBRrLK51AmF-c6Vc2%2F-LhkBg3LnqA8lHNZqn1i%2FGroup%206.png?alt=media\&token=7e8f9cfa-42bc-4594-a435-63b23f6fb757)

```javascript
k.verify("transactionId").
then((response) => {
    "performed_at": "2025-04-10T15:01:49.499Z",
    "type": "DEBIT",
    "status": "SUCCESS",
    "source": "MOBILE_MONEY",
    "source_common_name": "mtn-benin",

    "transactionId": "0845058258857440",

        "fullname": "John Doe",
        "phone": "22997000000",
        "email": "john.doe@gmail.com"
    }
}).
catch((error) => {
    //Gérer l'erreur
})
```

## **Refund a transaction**

Any ***success*** transaction made by mobile money can be subject to a refund operation. You have the possibility to make a refund if your customer hasn't obtained satisfaction for the service for which he paid or if you consider it necessary. In order to carry out such an operation, you will need to provide the following information:

* Your public, private and secret API keys

```javascript
})
```

# KKiaPay Direct

With KKiaPay Direct, get paid by WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and so many more !

### KKiaPay Direct : **What is it** ?&#x20;

KKiaPay Direct is a product of KKiaPay that allows you to generate unique and shareable payment links. It’s a link that can be hosted on a website, distributed on your social media (Facebook, Twitter and more) and directly accessible via Google. It is a customizable payment interface allowing your target to make donations or pay for your services.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MGm4LFG3J9RlLg7juXA%2F-MGnaZVLcx5-szli_bXt%2FAperc%CC%A7u.png?alt=media\&token=6e432f48-b2ea-4630-8083-eabdb8745d6f)

{% hint style="warning" %}
KKiaPay Direct is a feature accessible to anyone with an active KKiaPay account.
{% endhint %}

### How does it work ?

To generate your first payment link, follow the steps below :

#### Step 01

Start by filling in the reason why you want to generate a payment link. Do you want to sell items, raise funds, organize an event or simply get paid? The choice is yours.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MGm4LFG3J9RlLg7juXA%2F-MGn__FlSDkO6MNOKZIC%2F2-Direct.jpg?alt=media\&token=645899d0-a95a-45fa-aaed-87598b11e86f)

#### Step 02

Click on the "Generate a Link" button and choose the type of link you wish to generate.

There are two (02) types of links: **single payment link** and **multiple payment link**. Single payment links are non-reusable. They allow you to receive one and only one payment, unlike multiple payment links which can be used several times by several people.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MGm4LFG3J9RlLg7juXA%2F-MGn_n4i7qqaiE89eQ3v%2F3-Direct.jpg?alt=media\&token=95e4686a-8f54-4df9-a996-587b9ff81ab1)

#### Step 03

Fill in the information related to your link (Name, Amount to pay, Payment method, etc.) and click on the *"Generate link"* button.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MGm4LFG3J9RlLg7juXA%2F-MGna-QkHqLYUryDKmwU%2F5-Direct.jpg?alt=media\&token=1ad55693-112e-412a-a0b4-25abc482bc10)

Your payment link is then automatically generated and a preview is offered to you. It can be edited and shared on your various social networks (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn and WhatsApp), by email or SMS.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MGm4LFG3J9RlLg7juXA%2F-MGnd-789WnBjQXJMSYR%2F9-Direct.jpg?alt=media\&token=4d3c7ca3-f6c1-455d-bb45-04be3cba5aca)

To keep an eye on the various transactions carried out via this link, go to the details of the generated payment link and see the total amount collected, the number of people who paid via the link, the number of visits and the date of last use.


# KKiaPay POS

With KKiaPay POS, cash your payments without a website or mobile application !

The KKiaPay POS or KKiaPay point of sale is a product of KKiaPay that allows merchants without a website or mobile application to receive payments.&#x20;

{% hint style="warning" %}
KKiaPay POS is a feature accessible to anyone with an active KKiaPay account.
{% endhint %}

You wish to receive payments without a website or mobile application ? KKiaPay POS is what you’re looking for !

### How does it work ?&#x20;

Start by entering the amount to be debited to your customer, his Mobile Money number and optionally his first and last names as well as the reason for the transaction to be initialized. Click on the *"Cash Out"* button in order to send the payment request to your customer.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MGm4LFG3J9RlLg7juXA%2F-MGng4ktAFL_jtAkFEkc%2F2-POS.jpg?alt=media\&token=4d2ab816-e330-4a94-bad8-1dcee4159c42)

The customer will receive a USSD that he will have to confirm in order to authorize the payment.&#x20;

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MGm4LFG3J9RlLg7juXA%2F-MGngbItcUYNb5tlsqx8%2F4-POS.jpg?alt=media\&token=0a3f6dda-d809-4265-9415-9ed923fe0f0d)

Once the payment is authorized, you will receive a notification of success.&#x20;

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-MGm4LFG3J9RlLg7juXA%2F-MGngiIc_n5O0rG9RBMc%2F5-POS.jpg?alt=media\&token=538dfc6d-cebc-4bce-9b72-59abb06aec6a)

At this time, you can decide to :&#x20;

1. View payment details: They help you to keep an eye on the various statistics related to your transaction (the first and last names of your customer, the amount paid, the reference of the transaction as well as its origin).&#x20;
2. Send a receipt to your customer : Whether it’s using WhatsApp, SMS or your email, send your customers a receipt of his transaction.&#x20;
3. Access your transactions&#x20;
4. Cash out again


# KKiaPay Chap Chap

### What is kkiapay chap chap ?

**Chap chap** is the quick payment solution for your point of sale, allowing you to accept payments via MTN Momo, Moov Money, Celtiis Cash, and Coris Money in Benin.\
Your customer can pay you via QR code or USSD code :

* QR code : the customer scans the QR code with their phone's camera
* USSD : the customer types the USSD syntax on their phone's keypad : \*616\* 41 \* Merchant Code \* Amount#.

### Do I need a terminal or special device ?

You don't need a device or terminal. You receive your payments directly on your phone.

### How do I get my QR code ?

Contact our support team on WhatsApp: 01 52 53 17 17 or by phone: 01 61 15 15 61, and a kkiapay agent will come to your premises to give you your kkiapay chap chap kit.

### What if I already have a kkiapay terminal ?

You can continue to use your kkiapay payment terminal to take payments from your customers at the point of sale. The QR code can be used in parallel.

### What if I already have a kkiapay integration account ?

You can continue to use your kkiapay integration account to take payments from your customers remotely. The QR code can be used in parallel.

### What if I already have the kkiapay mobile app ?

You can continue to use your kkiapay mobile app account to collect payments from your customers. The QR code can be used in parallel.

### Do my customers need to register ?

Your customers do not need to register or create a kkiapay account. They just need a smartphone connected to the internet to scan the QR code or a basic phone to pay via USSD.

### What if my customers don't have internet access ?

They can pay via USSD using the following syntax : \*616\* 41 \* Merchant Code \* Amount#.

### What documents do I need to provide to open an account ?

To open a kkiapay QR code account, you must provide a valid form of ID.

### Can I collect payments by credit card with kkiapay chap chap ?

You cannot accept credit cards with kkiapay chap chap. If you want to accept credit cards at a point of sale, you must use the kkiapay POS terminal : <https://kkiapay.me/kkiapay-tpe>.

### How much does it cost ?

As a merchant, you incur fees on each mobile money transaction :

* 0 - 1,000 F: 25 F
* 1,001 - 5,000 F: 50 F
* 5001 - 50,000 F: 125 F
* 50,001 - 100,000 F: 5,000 F
* 100,000 F +: 1% of the amount

### When will I receive the money from my sales ?

The money from your sales is sent to you **immediately after each transaction** to the mobile money account of your choice.

### Can I track my payments ?

You will be notified of each payment on your WhatsApp number. A notification summarizing the day's activities is sent to you once a day. For details of your payments, you will need to log in to our web application [https://app.kkiapay.me](https://app.kkiapay.me/).

### What if my phone is turned off?

The customer can pay without any problems, and you will receive the operator's payment confirmation SMS and kkiapay notifications on WhatsApp when you turn your phone back on. If you have another device (phone or computer) that is turned on, you can track your transactions in the web application [https://app.kkiapay.me](https://app.kkiapay.me/).

### What should I do if a customer makes a payment ?

You should contact our support team via WhatsApp: +229 01 52 53 17 17 or by phone +229 01 61 15 15 61. If possible, send our support team a screenshot of the payment confirmation text message that the customer received.

### How can fraud be prevented ?

Transactions are secure and the customer must enter their PIN before authorizing a payment. To prevent fraudulent transactions, do not share your QR code with customers who are not physically at your point of sale. If you suspect fraud, contact our customer support immediately.

### What if I have a problem ?

Contact our customer support 7 days a week from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.: WhatsApp 01 52 53 17 17, phone 01 61 15 15 61, <support@kkiapay.me>.

### Can I have the same code several times in the same store ?

Yes, you can print your QR code as many times as you want to display it several times in the same store.

### If I want to change the number where I receive my money, how do I do it ?

If you want to change your payment number, simply contact our customer support.

### How do I change the number that receives WhatsApp notifications ?

To configure your WhatsApp notifications, you will need to log in to your account on our web application [https://app.kkiapay.me](https://app.kkiapay.me/), then click on the settings menu, then on the notifications tab.

### How do I refund a customer ?

If you need to refund a customer, you will need to do so directly from your mobile money account to which kkiapay has transferred the amount paid by the customer.

### Can I share my QR code via WhatsApp with a customer so they can pay me remotely ?

No, you are not supposed to share your QR code with a customer who wants to pay remotely. If you do so, the kkiapay compliance department will suspend your account.


# General Presentation

The KKiaPay dashboard provides you statistics that give you an overview of your balance, your transactions and any activity carried out by your person using your account. You are also provided with a characteristic curve of payments made according to the days of the week and an overview of the most commonly used payment methods on your platform.

## Dashboard Menus

Each menu in your dashboard manages a specific aspect of your account activity. Among the latter are:

* [Customers](/v1/en-1.0.0/tableau-de-bord/untitled/menu-clients) : it allows you to manage your customers;
* [Transactions](/v1/en-1.0.0/paiements/transactions) : it gives you an overview of the various transactions involving you;
* [Payouts](/v1/en-1.0.0/paiements/remboursements) : it gives you an overview of the various operations for returning your assets;
* [Developers](/v1/en-1.0.0/tableau-de-bord/untitled/menu-developpeurs) : it provides you with the various elements necessary to integrate the KKiaPay payment aggregator into your platform;
* [Settings](/v1/en-1.0.0/tableau-de-bord/untitled/menu-parametres) : it allows you to change your KKiaPay account information at any time.

## Statements

Download your data as an Excel file to keep your accounting up to date or to consult it at your leisure.

Your dashboard contains a certain amount of data. We make it easier for you to search by providing you a search bar and a certain number of filters (filter by date, filter by period, filter by type).

# Menu

Votre tableau de bord KKiaPay est composé d'un menu riche en fonctionnalités. Prenez connaissance des diverses fonctionnalités dont vous disposez.


# Transactions

The "**Transactions**" menu on your KKiaPay dashboard provides you with a detailed and chronological list of your various transactions. Ranked from the most recent to the oldest, the following data is available for each transaction:

* The type of transaction ;
* The status of the transaction ;
* The source of the transaction ;
* The transaction reference ;&#x20;
* The amount of the transaction ;
* The transaction fees ;
* The phone number of the initiator of the transaction ;&#x20;
* The date of the transaction.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-L_JMJTERiPBt-91MBVL%2F-L_JMVpZTrS09zAAI8Zk%2FRectangle24.png?alt=media\&token=ea3250c3-2320-4f81-8b41-e345d03dd9f5)

The status of a transaction is a variable that can have the following values :  &#x20;

* **Success**: the transaction was completed without any problems;&#x20;
* **Failure**: the transaction operation could not be successfully completed;&#x20;
* **Pending**: the transaction operation is currently being processed.

It is also possible in this menu to refund a transaction if it is a success. To do this, simply select the transaction and click on the "**Refund**" button. Note that the list of your transactions can be downloaded in CSV format (Excel file).

##


# Customers

The "**Customers**" menu in your KKiaPay dashboard provides you a complete and filterable list of your customers. For a given customer is available:

* His full name ;&#x20;
* His email address ;
* His phone number ; &#x20;
* His country of residence.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-L_JMJTERiPBt-91MBVL%2F-L_JMVp1tCb55t2ByFZB%2FRectangle1.png?alt=media\&token=54ff40a9-3e06-4b2f-900d-61ce117d2e54)


# Payouts

The "**Payouts**" menu of your KKiaPay dashboard provides you with a detailed and chronological list of the reversals made by KKiaPay and to which you are subject. Are available for each of the items in this list:&#x20;

* The amount repaid;&#x20;
* The date of the operation;&#x20;
* The status of the operation;&#x20;
* The amount deducted by KKiaPay during the repayment operation;&#x20;
* Information related to the account (mobile money or bank account) being the subject of the transaction.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-L_JMJTERiPBt-91MBVL%2F-L_JMVpRsfNhuN8hp1CN%2FRectangle16.png?alt=media\&token=6b686adc-7def-4d93-a4a6-2f17a8bbdf78)

The status of a payout operation is a variable that can have the following values:&#x20;

* **Success**: the payout operation was completed without any problems ;&#x20;
* **Failure**: the payout operation could not be completed ;&#x20;
* **Pending**: the payout operation is in progress ;

Please note that the list of your various outpayment operations can be downloaded in CSV format (Excel file).


# Developers

The "**Developers**" menu offers you with his submenu "**API Keys**" and "**Logs**" a technical overview of the various activities in your account.

### API keys

There are three (03) KKiaPay API keys, required to integrate the payment aggregator, that identify you as a KKiaPay approved user.

\
Customer-oriented, the **KKiaPay public key** can be integrated into your Javascript and Android code and is intended to be entered on your WordPress table in the Settings section of our WordPress plugin.&#x20;

**The KKiaPay private key**, only known by you and KKiaPay, is intended for server-side use and allows the verification of transactions made on your account by the KKiaPay API.&#x20;

The latest KKiaPay API key, the **secret key** is a key for server-side use to transfer to your KKiaPay account.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-L_JMJTERiPBt-91MBVL%2F-L_JMVpP-xF4PkKaW6mI%2FRectangle14.png?alt=media\&token=d86da402-ed8b-48fc-ad05-897b69953397)

### Logs

This submenu provides you with a complete list of the various requests initiated from your KKiaPay account. For a given request, the following information is available:&#x20;

* The client that initiated the request (Android, Rest, WooCommerce);&#x20;
* The IP address of the initiator;&#x20;
* The resource used; The method used (POST, GET, PUT, etc.);&#x20;
* The date on which the said request was initiated;&#x20;
* The country from which this request was initiated;&#x20;
* The host.

Please note that the list of various requests initiated from your KKiaPay account can be downloaded in CSV format (Excel file).


# Settings

The configurable "**Settings**" menu in your KKiaPay dashboard refers not only to your profile but also to the banks and mobile money accounts linked to yours. It has the following three (03) sections: Profile, Bank Account and Users.&#x20;

### Profile

The "**Profile**" section offers you the possibility to modify your personal and your company information. The following information can be modified:

* **Personal information**: Your full name, email address and password;
* **Company information**: Your name, phone number, physical address and link to the website.

The "**Bank account**" section allows you to add a bank account to your KKiaPay account or delete one.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-L_JMJTERiPBt-91MBVL%2F-L_JMVp2VJ9bBiiXCL7c%2FRectangle2.png?alt=media\&token=facb629e-2144-443c-81ae-90a4a16e93bd)

In the case of a company, in addition to the above information, there is a digitized copy of your Business License.

### Mobile Money Account

You can link a valid Mobile Money account to your account in order to receive your payments. To do this, you will need to enter the phone number and confirm it with KKiaPay.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-L_JMJTERiPBt-91MBVL%2F-L_JMVp4gkAIn8eAC8xN%2FRectangle4.png?alt=media\&token=b250fe09-e133-43d1-af8f-f88a087cdb99)

### User

You have the possibility in the "**Users**" section to enlarge your team by inviting a user to KKiaPay. It is then up to you to define the rights of the latter on your KKiaPay account. He may be:&#x20;

* A **financier**: He analyses the evolution of your company and has only reading rights;&#x20;
* A **developer**: He takes care of the technical aspect of your company. It has editing and reading rights on your account;&#x20;
* An **administrator**: He has the same rights as your person on your KKiaPay account.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-L_JMJTERiPBt-91MBVL%2F-L_JMVpdks9fcm2w7RgQ%2FRectangle29.png?alt=media\&token=86a3c466-8a5c-4bf5-a1f6-3fadc7ae635f)


# Webhook

When an event occurs on your KKiaPay account you can use the webhooks provided by KKiaPay to keep an eye on their execution. To date, you can use webhooks to notify your backend of the status of a transaction (*is the transaction a success or a failure*).

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlX03i_Cmqa7NKeCU0a%2F-LlXBkIxN2FOPx5FznRq%2FCapture%20d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran%202019-08-05%20a%CC%80%2014.46.png?alt=media\&token=ea5308a2-7b87-4bc3-8e5a-5d201f4e5f8c)

### Configuration of webhooks&#x20;

In order to configure your webhooks, you will need to follow the steps below once on the form to add a webhook available after clicking on the "*Add a webhook*" button in the Webhook tab of the [API Keys](/v1/en-1.0.0/tableau-de-bord/untitled/menu-developpeurs#api-keys) submenu of your dashboard:

1. Enter the URL on which you want to be notified. You can enter any URL as the destination for events. However, it must be a dedicated page on your server, configured to receive events.
2. Choose the events for which you want to be notified. You will only be notified of the specified events.
3. Define a hash secret. It will be used to verify the source of the information you receive.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlX03i_Cmqa7NKeCU0a%2F-LlXDWBaDIfs2A3KwgXi%2FCapture%20d%E2%80%99e%CC%81cran%202019-08-05%20a%CC%80%2014.47.png?alt=media\&token=d338a626-569c-4b5e-9316-1630832eb814)

Once the callback has been created, you can perform a test to verify that KKiaPay is contacting your URL.

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlX03i_Cmqa7NKeCU0a%2F-LlXInm6gqgygsql5uwv%2FGroup%2010.png?alt=media\&token=6d646821-03fd-4afe-90a2-fae9172b6fd2)

### Manage webhooks

It is important to know how to acknowledge receipt of an event after notification from KKiaPay. To do this, you must first use your URL to identify the type of event and return an HTTP 2xx status code. All response codes outside this range, including 3xx codes, tell KKiaPay that you have not received the event.&#x20;

{% hint style="info" %}
In case of non-receipt KKiaPay tries 5 times in a row (in an interval of 500ms incremental) to send you the information.&#x20;
{% endhint %}

### Verification of webhook signatures

KKiaPay signs webhooks events before sending them to your URLs. Indeed, in the header of each x-kkiapay-secret request (using your hash secret previously entered on your dashboard), a signature is entered. It is used to allow you to verify that the events were sent by KKiaPay and not by a third party.

The skeleton of the request is as follows:

```
curl -H "x-kkiapay-secret: XXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json http://example.com/webhook
```

{% hint style="info" %}
Any x-kkiapay-secret request uses the hash secret provided by your person on the KKiaPay dashboard.
{% endhint %}

![](https://1213620691-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-legacy-files/o/assets%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92%2F-LlX03i_Cmqa7NKeCU0a%2F-LlXLtjsFfpmtrsyjoLa%2FGroup%2011.png?alt=media\&token=8be8d8c8-81fa-4052-9825-c114645ad454)

### **Payloads Response Body**

With each event notification we send you a body request in json format below:&#x20;

* In the case of a failed transaction

```javascript
{
    "transactionId": "erjEU5P9o",
    "isPaymentSucces": false,
    "account": "22996000001", // null for card and wave payments,
    "failureCode": "processing_error",
    "failureMessage": "processing_error",
    "label": "...",
    "method": "MOBILE_MONEY", // MOBILE_MONEY | WALLET | CARD,
    "amount": 1000,
    "fees": 19,
    "partnerId": "...",
    "performedAt": "2024-03-20T08:55:22.883Z",
    "stateData": {},
    "event": "transaction.failed"
}

```

* In the case of a successful transaction

```javascript
{
    "transactionId": "3iH6wjHJ3",
    "isPaymentSucces": true,
    "account": "22996000000", // null for card and wave payments,
    "label": "...",
    "method": "MOBILE_MONEY", // MOBILE_MONEY | WALLET | CARD,
    "amount": 1000,
    "fees": 19,
    "partnerId": "...",
    "performedAt": "2024-03-20T08:55:22.883Z",
    "stateData": {},
    "event": "transaction.success"
}
```

<br>


# Security provisions

Security being one of the most important considerations of our system various measures have been taken to ensure it.

### Secure connections via HTTPS and HSTS&#x20;

All communications are encrypted by TLS (Transport Layer Security) including the KKiaPay site and dashboard. The communications between the REST API, the various SDKs and the server are only possible in HTTPS (HyperText Transfer Protocol Secure) and all communications are encrypted by&#x20;

The details of our implementation such as: the certificates we use, the certification authorities we use and the encryption we support are regularly subject to verification.

HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) is used to ensure that regardless of the browser, interactions with KKiaPay take place only via HTTPS.

Encryption of sensitive data and communications All sensitive data is encrypted on disk in AES-256 (Advanced Encryption Standard). Decryption keys are stored on separate machines. As a result, none of KKiaPay's internal servers or services have access to this data. On the other hand, internal modules are allowed to send this data to the payment solution provider.

### Authentication and confidentiality

&#x20;In order to ensure the authenticity and confidentiality of our solution, the following measures have been taken :

* Restriction of access to the dashboard only to users who have gone through email and password authentication implemented on the basis of the recommendations of the OAUTH2 protocol;
* Double authentication (optional) by SMS or QR Code requested before each access to the dashboard;
* The use of the API is protected by explicit control of request headers;
* The generation of a unique RSA key pair for each service provider to authenticate its requests and decrypt its information;
* The implementation of CORS (Cross Origin Resource Sharing) and CSRF (Cross Site Request Forgery) protections to ensure a trusting exchange between the service provider's sites/applications and KKiaPay.


# Suspicious email and website

*You have received an email and don't know if it is really KKiaPay? You don't know how to react and especially how you can verify if it's a legitimate email from KKiaPay?*

Phishing attacks occur when a malicious source tries to get you to provide confidential information by pretending to be a legitimate company, a colleague or someone you trust. They often look a lot like official emails, websites, tweets, Facebook posts, etc., and can easily obtain your personal information if you are not on the lookout.

&#x20;KKiaPay regularly sends notification emails. If you need to ensure that the email is legal you'll have to:

* Check the URL before clicking on a link. On a web browser you will have to hover over the link and look at the URL that will appear at the bottom of your browser to make sure that it actually points to a page in the domain *app.kkiapay.me*.

{% hint style="info" %}
Our emails will always come from the domain ***app.kkiapay.me*** !
{% endhint %}

* Check the domain name to make sure it is the same as ***kkiapay***. The aim is to avoid simulacra such as: *kkaipay, kkiapaiy,* etc.
* Verify if the extended validation certificate who look lie a green look is next to the URL. This extended validation certificate help you make sure that you are actually on the KKiaPay website.&#x20;

If you suspect a phishing attempt, send us the full message via our contact page. More importantly, stay alert!

# Introduction

La présente documentation présente la procédure d’intégration de notre plateforme d’agrégation de solutions digitales de paiement à votre plateforme de e-commerce ou à votre application de services.

**kkiapay** est une marque commerciale déposée par [Open SI SA](http://opensi.co/), entreprise de services informatiques régulièrement enregistrée en République du Bénin. La plateforme d’agrégation de solutions électroniques de paiement désignée par la marque "kkiapay" sise à l’adresse [kkiapay.me](http://kkiapay.me/) ainsi que tous les modules qu’elle fournit sont la propriété entière et indivisible de Open SI SAS.

Notre infrastructure solide et flexible vous fournira l'expérience de traitement de paiement dont vous avez besoin pour encaisser vos clients électroniquement en présentiel ou à distance. En suivant les étapes décrites dans la présente documentation, vous pourrez intégrer l'API kkiapay en quelques secondes et recevoir vos premiers paiements dès aujourd’hui ! Sur votre site-web ou dans notre application mobile, vous pourrez également intégrer nos bibliothèques, plugins et SDK et offrir à vos clients la meilleure expérience de paiement possible.

Vous démarrez une boutique en ligne, un système de point de vente ou une activité de financement ? Nous sommes là pour vous aider ! Posez-nous vos questions ou faites-nous part de vos incompréhensions en appelant le +229 61151561 ou en écrivant à <support@kkiapay.me>.&#x20;

Notre équipe de support est disponible pour vous aider.


# kkiapay

Conçu pour vous, ce guide met à votre disposition les informations nécessaires à la prise en main et l'utilisation de kkiapay.

## Bienvenue sur kkiapay !

Agrégateur de paiement, kkiapay est un outil qui vous offre la possibilité de recevoir des paiements de partout dans le monde. Il est, une solution conviviale, dont l'intégration vous offre la possibilité d’accepter les paiements effectués par Mobile Money (tous opérateurs confondus) et par Cartes de Crédit (locales et internationales).

L'utilisation de kkiapay requiert à tous de disposer d'un compte marchand valide. Si vous n'en avez pas encore, vous pouvez dès à présent procéder à [sa création](https://kkiapay.me/). C'est gratuit !

kkiapay met à votre disposition SDKs ou Plugins dépendamment des technologies que vous utilisez afin de faciliter son intégration.

{% tabs %}
{% tab title="Avec une plateforme Native (Web ou Mobile )" %}
Un SDK Javascript et un SDK Android sont disponibles et intégrables au code de votre application.&#x20;
{% endtab %}

{% tab title="Avec un CMS" %}
Vous disposez également de plugins WooCommerce et Give intégrables à votre plateforme lorsque celle-ci est développée avec Wordpress.
{% endtab %}
{% endtabs %}


# Création d'un compte

Créez votre compte pour encaisser votre premier paiement dès aujourd’hui !

Avec votre numéro de téléphone ou votre adresse mail, procédez à la création de votre compte kkiapay et offrez à vos clients l’expérience kkiapay. Dans votre application mobile ou sur votre site web, sur WhatsApp, Facebook, Messenger, et même par SMS, faites-vous payer en un seul clic. Que vous vendiez à l’échelle locale ou internationale, acceptez les paiements de partout dans le monde en créant votre compte dès maintenant.

Pour commencer, choisissez comment vous souhaitez créer votre compte kkiapay. Souhaitez-vous créer votre compte kkiapay à partir de votre numéro de téléphone ou de votre adresse mail ?

### Créer mon compte kkiapay à partir de mon numéro de téléphone

Afin d'initier le processus de création de votre compte kkiapay, renseignez le numéro de téléphone que vous souhaitez lier à votre compte kkiapay et choisissez l'offre kkiapay qui suit le mieux à l'expérience que vous souhaitez offrir à vos clients. Souhaitez-vous bénéficier de l'offre standard de kkiapay ou de celle professionnelle ?

![](https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2FA0Wyz6lzHiBDlH21o00M%2F1.jpg?alt=media\&token=37cc5c84-67c4-4ff9-acfa-9e1e3c3d8f47)

Une fois la réponse à cette question renseignée dans le champ "*Sélectionnez une offre*" cliquez sur le bouton "*Valider*" pour continuer. Vous recevrez alors, sur le numéro de téléphone fourni, un code de vérification à six (06) chiffres. Renseignez-le dans les champs prévus à cet effet et cliquez sur le bouton "*Vérifier*" pour continuer.&#x20;

![](https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2FfRLXi67rjLMNHjHCd8jo%2F2.jpg?alt=media\&token=ce334ace-5b06-435b-a6f0-537f26d1c72c)

{% hint style="warning" %}
Si vous n'avez pas reçu de code de vérification, cliquez sur le lien "*Renvoyer le code*" pour demander un nouveau code de vérification.
{% endhint %}

Si vous êtes arrivés jusque-là, avant tout chose : **FÉLICITATIONS !** Il ne vous reste plus qu’une étape pour commencer par collecter vos paiements.&#x20;

Dans le formulaire de renseignement qui s'affiche après vérification du code, saisissez :

* Vos noms et prénoms
* Votre adresse mail
* Le nom de votre entreprise

Continuez-en choisissant votre mot de passe. Ce dernier se doit de contenir :

* Une lettre majuscule
* 8 caractères minimum
* Un chiffre&#x20;
* Un caractère spécial (#?\*+/)

Cliquez sur le bouton "*Suivant* " pour demander la création de votre compte kkiapay.&#x20;

![](https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2Fa0OTUwim4whYOdkNW0WW%2F3.jpg?alt=media\&token=7d2d255b-9dbd-47ee-b4f2-6d33cad3be9a)

Lisez et acceptez les diverses conditions générales d'utilisation de kkiapay et cliquez sur le bouton "*Suivant* " pour confirmer votre demande de création de compte et effectivement créer votre compte kkiapay.

# Activation de compte

Demandez en quelques clics l'activation de votre compte kkiapay pour commencer à recevoir des paiements de partout dans le monde.

La création d'un compte kkiapay vous permet dans l'immédiat d'interagir avec l'environnement kkiapay en mode test. Toutes les fonctionnalités de kkiapay sont disponibles en mode test, mais vous ne pouvez réaliser aucune réelle transaction. Pour commencer à accepter des paiements clients, vous devez avant tout disposer d'un compte actif.

L'activation de votre compte kkiapay est un processus simple. En effet, vous pouvez la demander dans le menu **Activer mon compte** de votre tableau de bord.

{% hint style="warning" %}
Toutes les pièces soumises pour l'activation de compte doivent être des versions scannées et claires des documents originaux.
{% endhint %}

## La demande d'activation de compte

Pour demander l'activation de votre compte kkiapay, il vous faut, dans les trois sections ci-dessous citées renseigner les informations demandées :

1. **Informations personnelles**
2. **Informations concernant l’entreprise**
3. **Documents administratifs**

![](https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2Fj3scQJMZpigHbZO5qyN7%2FDA%201.jpg?alt=media\&token=63f27505-5679-4181-9cad-c3fd4a7ce24d)

Après avoir renseigné vos noms et prénoms, téléphone et votre rôle dans la section "***Informations personnelles**"*, remplissez le formulaire d'informations concernant votre entreprise en fournissant :

* le nom de votre entreprise
* votre domaine d'activité
* le lien de votre site web ou application (si vous en possédez)
* le téléphone de l'entreprise et le pays dans lequel il est enregistré (Bénin ou Côte d'Ivoire)
* l'adresse physique de l'entreprise

![](https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2FFG67SMymOjhOGLJnGdXQ%2FDA%202.jpg?alt=media\&token=fa3d708c-1dbf-4336-8464-1efabfe79af0)

![](https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2FiJ71tk2XZcPIptTHXVSZ%2FDA%203.jpg?alt=media\&token=963284ce-acf5-479d-9b40-b3c27078b06f)

Dans la section "***Documents administratifs*****"** du processus de validation, vous devez fournir les documents justificatifs de votre activité. Les documents requis à cette étape varient en fonction du type de votre entreprise et du pays dans lequel il est enregistré.&#x20;

### Pour les entreprises enregistrées au Bénin

#### 1. Établissements/entreprises individuelles/sociétés

Pour effectuer une demande d'activation de compte, les établissements, entreprises individuelles et sociétés doivent fournir :

* le numéro de leur Registre de Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier&#x20;
* une copie de leur Registre de Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier&#x20;
* le numéro de leur Identifiant Fiscale Unique
* une copie de leur Identifiant Fiscale Unique
* la pièce d'identité (carte d'identité ou passeport) du gérant de l'entreprise

#### 2. Organisation Non Gouvernementale (ONG)

Pour demander l'activation de son compte kkiapay, l'ONG ou l'association doit fournir :

* une copie du procès-verbal de son assemblée constitutive&#x20;
* une copie de son récépissé de déclaration
* la pièce d'identité (carte d'identité ou passeport) du président de l'ONG (ou association)

#### 3. Consultant individuel

Pour sa demande d'activation de compte, le consultant individuel doit fournir :

* son numéro d'Identifiant Fiscale Unique
* une copie de son Identifiant Fiscale Unique
* sa date de naissance
* un justificatif de domicile (encore appelé attestation de résidence)
* sa pièce d'identité (carte d'identité ou passeport)

<figure><img src="https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2F2MjpZnaKcg4X3ssK3qMY%2FDA%206.jpg?alt=media&amp;token=0be10a16-aa5a-422c-9772-9fc01ccd46d1" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

* le numéro de leur Registre de Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier&#x20;
* une copie de leur Registre de Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier&#x20;
* le numéro de leur Déclaration Fiscale D’existence (DFE)
* une copie de leur Déclaration Fiscale D’existence
* leur Numéro De Compte Contribuable (NCC)
* la pièce d'identité (carte d'identité ou passeport) du gérant de l'entreprise

#### 2. Organisation Non Gouvernementale (ONG)

Pour demander l'activation de son compte kkiapay, l'ONG enregistrée en Côte d'Ivoire doit fournir :

* une copie de son procès-verbal&#x20;
* son récépissé de d'immatriculation
* la pièce d'identité (carte d'identité ou passeport) du président de l'ONG (ou association)

<figure><img src="https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2Fi79oZrkNKVNRo2I2CNU0%2FDA%208.jpg?alt=media&amp;token=ec8d115a-58e8-49c5-a215-a820661c50ca" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

Terminez, en cliquant sur le bouton ***Envoyer la demande de vérification**.*

<figure><img src="https://3656574980-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LX3NlYdn5V7BnDqQm92-887967055%2Fuploads%2FWuBzLwTrOCsFXmz7jjpR%2FDA%209.jpg?alt=media&amp;token=1eff815a-7a46-4280-a107-c3c148bbd06c" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

En 24 heures, notre équipe se chargera de vérifier vos documents afin d’activer votre compte pour commencer par recevoir vos paiements à distance.

Ces exigences proviennent de nos organismes de réglementation et de nos partenaires financiers et visent à prévenir les fraudes, abus du système financier. Les informations que vous fournissez sont examinées en interne pour s'assurer qu'elles sont conformes à notre contrat de services. Si nous avons besoin de plus d'informations, nous vous contacterons immédiatement.<br>


# kkiapay Sandbox : Guide de Test

Avec kkiapay Sandbox, testez les fonctionnalités de kkiapay en usant des informations de test mises à votre disposition.

La sandbox de kkiapay est un environnement de test virtuel autonome qui imite l’environnement de production kkiapay. Il fournit un espace sécurisé où vous pouvez lancer et regarder votre application, traiter les demandes que vous adressez aux API kkiapay *sans toucher à aucun compte kkiapay actif* .

Lorsque vous créez votre compte, kkiapay vous envoie un courrier électronique de Bienvenue à l'adresse que vous avez spécifié. Le contenu de ce courriel vous instruit sur la démarche à suivre afin de demander l'activation de votre compte marchand. Si vous ne recevez pas cet e-mail quelques minutes après votre inscription, vérifiez qu'il n'a pas été bloqué ni transféré vers un dossier de courrier indésirable.

Ne laissez s'écouler que quelques secondes entre la création et votre prise en main de l'environnement kkiapay. En effet, une fois votre compte créé, accédez à la fonctionnalité Sandbox en vous connectant à la plateforme web kkiapay à l'aide des informations d'identification de votre compte.

## Sandbox : Vue d'ensemble

La sandbox de kkiapay reflète les fonctionnalités présentes sur les serveurs de production kkiapay. Bien que certaines fonctionnalités de kkiapay ne s'appliquent pas en sandbox, cette dernière présente une parité avec le jeu de fonctionnalités de l'API de kkiapay pris en charge par l'environnement en direct. Cela signifie que vous pouvez tester vos processus kkiapay dans l'environnement sandbox et savoir qu'ils se comporteront de la même manière sur les serveurs de production.

En utilisant l'environnement de test sandbox fictif et les informations de compte associées dans vos appels d'API kkiapay, vous pouvez tester et débuguer votre application sans faire référence à un utilisateur kkiapay réel. L'environnement sandbox vous permet d'exploiter votre application dans un environnement sécurisé et vous permet d'ajuster avec précision vos routines kkiapay avant de mettre votre produit en production.

Lorsque vous lancez une transaction à l'aide d'un compte en sandbox, kkiapay crée une transaction fictive qui se comporte exactement comme une transaction dans l'environnement en direct. Pendant votre phase de test, utilisez les points de terminaison sandbox et les détails de votre compte de test dans chaque demande d'API kkiapay que vous effectuez.

## Informations associées

Les informations liées à votre compte marchand ne peuvent (et ne doivent) être utilisées en mode test. Nous vous fournissons pour cela des informations de test que vous pourrez utiliser pour effectuer vos paiements tests.

Pour simuler tous les scénarios de transactions par mobile money que vous jugerez nécessaires avant de passer en production sur votre compte live, nous mettons à votre disposition les numéros ci-après :<br>
